units.zh: 武皇帝諱炎，字安世，文帝長子也。
units.en: The emperor honored posthumously as Wu bore the personal name Yan and the courtesy name Anshi; he was the firstborn son of Emperor Wen (Sima Zhao).
units.literal: The Martial Emperor's taboo name was Yan, his style name Anshi; he was the eldest son of Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 寬惠仁厚，沈深有度量。
units.en: Broad-minded, humane, and gentle by nature, he was grave and self-contained, with the measured bearing of a true ruler.
units.literal: He was generous, kind, and humane in his magnanimity, deep and reserved, with breadth of mind.

units.zh: 魏嘉平中，封北平亭侯，歷給事中、奉車都尉、中壘將軍，加散騎常侍，累遷中護軍、假節。
units.en: During Wei’s Jiaping years he received the Beipingting marquisate and rose through a string of palace and guard posts—gentleman in attendance, commandant of the imperial chariots, general of the central rampart, cavalier attendant-in-ordinary—until he became central protector, bearing the credential staff.
units.literal: In the Jiaping era of Wei he was enfeoffed as marquis of Beipingting, then served successively as gentleman in attendance, commandant of the imperial chariots, general of the central rampart, with additional appointment as regular palace attendant of cavalier, and was repeatedly promoted to central protector with plenary authority.

units.zh: 迎常道鄉公於東武陽，遷中撫軍，進封新昌鄉侯。
units.en: At Dongwuyang he received the duke of Changdaoxiang, was named central commander of the army, and was promoted to marquis of Xinchang.
units.literal: He welcomed the duke of Changdaoxiang at Dongwuyang, was transferred to central commander of the army, and advanced to enfeoffment as marquis of Xinchang.

units.zh: 及晉國建，立爲世子，拜撫軍大將軍，開府、副貳相國。
units.en: When the Jin state was founded, he was established as heir apparent, appointed Great General Who Pacifies the Army with an office of his own, and made second-in-command assisting the Minister of State.
units.literal: When the state of Jin was founded he was established as heir apparent, appointed great general who pacifies the army with independent command, and served as deputy to the minister of state.

units.zh: 初，文帝以景帝既宣帝之嫡，早世無後，以帝弟攸爲嗣，特加愛異，自謂攝居相位，百年之後，大業宜歸攸。
units.en: Earlier, Emperor Wen, because Emperor Jing was Emperor Xuan’s legitimate heir but had died young without descendants, made the emperor’s younger brother You his successor and showed him exceptional favor. He considered himself only temporarily occupying the position of minister of state, and believed that after a hundred years the great enterprise should pass to You.
units.literal: At first, because prince Jing (Sima Shi), as the legitimate heir of emperor Xuan, had died young without posterity, emperor Wen had taken the emperor's younger brother You as successor and shown him exceptional favor; believing himself only provisionally to hold the chancellorship, he expected that after his death the great enterprise ought to pass to You.

units.zh: 每曰：「此景王之天下也，吾何與焉。」
units.en: He was fond of saying, “This is really prince Jing’s world, not mine.”
units.literal: He would often say, "This is prince Jing's realm; what have I to do with it?"

units.zh: 將議立世子，屬意於攸。
units.en: When the time came to choose an heir, his heart was set on You.
units.literal: When they were about to deliberate on installing the heir apparent, his inclination settled on You.

units.zh: 何曾等固爭曰：「中撫軍聰明神武，有超世之才。
units.en: He Zeng and his colleagues firmly argued, "The central commander of the army is intelligent, divinely martial, and has talent beyond the age.
units.literal: He Zeng and others firmly argued, saying, "The central commander of the army is astute, martial, and divinely awe-inspiring; he has talents surpassing the age.

units.zh: 髮委地，手過膝，此非人臣之相也。」
units.en: His hair reaches the floor and his hands hang below the knees—marks of a sovereign, not a subject.”
units.literal: His hair trails to the ground and his hands pass his knees; these are not the features of a minister."

units.zh: 由是遂定。
units.en: On that basis the choice was fixed.
units.literal: On this account the matter was finally settled.

units.zh: 咸熙二年五月，立爲晉王太子。
units.en: In the fifth month of the second year of Xianxi, he was named crown prince to the king of Jin.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Xianxi he was established as crown prince of the king of Jin.

units.zh: 八月辛卯，文帝崩，太子嗣相國、晉王位。
units.en: On xinmao in the eighth month Wen died, and the crown prince inherited both the minister of state’s portfolio and the kingship of Jin.
units.literal: On the day xinmao of the eighth month emperor Wen died; the crown prince succeeded to the offices of minister of state and king of Jin.

units.zh: 下令寬刑宥罪，撫眾息役，國內行服三日。
units.en: He ordered punishments lightened, offenses pardoned, the people soothed, and corvée suspended, while the court wore mourning for three days.
units.literal: He issued orders to lighten punishments and pardon crimes, console the people and halt corvée labor, and for three days within the state mourning dress was worn.

units.zh: 是月，長人見於襄武，長三丈，告縣人王始曰：「今當太平。」
units.en: That month, a tall man appeared at Xiangwu, three zhang in height, and told the county man Wang Shi, "Now there will be great peace."
units.literal: That month a man of extraordinary height appeared at Xiangwu, three zhang tall, and told the county man Wang Shi, "Now there shall be great peace."

units.zh: 九月戊午，以魏司徒何曾爲丞相，鎮南將軍王沈爲御史大夫，中護軍賈充爲衛將軍，議郎裴秀爲尚書令、光祿大夫，皆開府。
units.en: On wuwu in the ninth month he formed his core cabinet: He Zeng as chancellor, Wang Chen as imperial counselor, Jia Chong as guard general, Pei Xiu as director of the Secretariat and grand officer of splendid happiness, each with full general’s establishment.
units.literal: On the day wuwu of the ninth month he appointed He Zeng, steward of Wei, as chancellor; Wang Chen, general who guards the south, as imperial counselor; Jia Chong, central protector, as guard general; Pei Xiu, gentleman in discussion, as supervisor of the masters of writing and grand officer of brilliant prosperity—all with independent commands.

units.zh: 十一月，初置四護軍，以統城外諸軍。
units.en: In the eleventh month he created four “army protector” posts to oversee every garrison beyond the capital.
units.literal: In the eleventh month he first established four army protectors to command all the armies outside the walls.

units.zh: 乙未，令諸郡中正以六條舉淹滯：一曰忠恪匪躬，二曰孝敬盡禮，三曰友于兄弟，四曰潔身勞謙，五曰信義可復，六曰學以爲己。
units.en: On yiwei he ordered the commandery-level evaluators to raise overlooked talent under six rubrics: loyal service, filial piety, fraternal harmony, modest integrity, reliable good faith, and learning pursued for its own sake.
units.literal: On yiwei he ordered the impartial evaluators (zhongzheng) of commanderies to recommend the long-neglected and obstructed according to six criteria: first, loyalty and conscientiousness sacrificing self; second, filial respect fulfilling ritual; third, harmony among brothers; fourth, purity of person with humble industry; fifth, trustworthiness and righteousness that can be relied upon; sixth, learning for one’s own moral cultivation.

units.zh: 是時晉德既洽，四海宅心。
units.en: By then Jin’s moral authority had spread so widely that the empire looked to it as the natural center.
units.literal: At this time the virtue of Jin had already permeated the realm, and all within the four seas made it their home.

units.zh: 於是天子知曆數有在，乃使太保鄭沖奉策曰：「咨爾晉王：我皇祖有虞氏誕膺靈運，受終于陶唐，亦以命于有夏。
units.en: Thereupon the Son of Heaven knew that the calendrical count had found its place, and sent Grand Guardian Zheng Chong to present the writ, saying, “I address you, King of Jin: our august ancestor, the Youyu clan, broadly received the numinous fortune and accepted the completion from Tao Tang, and it was likewise mandated to Xia.
units.literal: Thereupon the son of heaven knew that the celestial mandate rested with Jin, and sent grand guardian Zheng Chong to present the edict, saying, "I address you, king of Jin: Our august ancestor Youyu received the numinous fortune and accepted the abdication from Tao Tang; likewise he enjoined Xia.

units.zh: 惟三后陟配于天，而咸用光敷聖德。
units.en: Each of the three sage-kings rose to partner Heaven and spread his virtue abroad.
units.literal: The three later sovereigns ascended to match heaven, and all alike spread abroad their sagely power.

units.zh: 自茲厥後，天又輯大命于漢。
units.en: Afterward Heaven gathered the mandate once more in Han.
units.literal: From that time onward heaven again gathered the great mandate upon Han.

units.zh: 火德既衰，乃眷命我高祖。
units.en: When Han’s “fire” virtue faded, it looked to our founding ancestor.
units.literal: When the virtue of fire had waned, it then turned its favor to our high ancestor.

units.zh: 方軌虞夏四代之明顯，我不敢知。
units.en: Whether we truly match the luminous succession of Yu, Xia, and what lies between—I would not presume to say.
units.literal: Whether we parallel the luminous models of Yu, Xia, and the two intervening reigns, I dare not claim to know.

units.zh: 惟王乃祖乃父，服膺明哲，輔亮我皇家，勳德光于四海。
units.en: Yet your forebears, generation after generation, served our dynasty with enlightened wisdom; their achievements lit the realm.
units.literal: Only your ancestors and fathers embraced enlightened wisdom and assisted our royal house; their merit and virtue shone throughout the four seas.

units.zh: 格爾上下神祇，罔不克順，地平天成，萬邦以乂。
units.en: You have won the assent of gods above and below; the cosmos is ordered and every land is ruled aright.
units.literal: You have moved the spirits high and low; none have failed to obey; earth is level and heaven complete, and the myriad regions are well governed.

units.zh: 應受上帝之命，協皇極之中。
units.en: You are fit to take up Heaven’s charge and hold the central balance of the realm.
units.literal: You ought to receive the charge of the high lord and harmonize the supreme pivot.

units.zh: 肆予一人，祗承天序，以敬授爾位，曆數實在爾躬。
units.en: Therefore I, humble as I am, bow to the succession of Heaven and solemnly hand you the throne—the mandate plainly rests with you.
units.literal: Therefore I, the solitary man, reverently accept the celestial sequence and respectfully transmit to you your position; the reckoning of the mandate is truly in your person.

units.zh: 允執其中，天祿永終。
units.en: Hold fast to the middle way, and Heaven’s favor will not end.
units.literal: Faithfully hold the mean; heaven’s blessing will be endless.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Oh!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 王其欽順天命。
units.en: May you, king, bow to what Heaven commands.
units.literal: May the king respectfully obey heaven’s command.

units.zh: 率循訓典，底綏四國，用保天休，無替我二皇之弘烈。」
units.en: Walk in the tracks of the classics, pacify the four quarters, secure Heaven’s favor, and do not dishonor the mighty work of our two sage predecessors.”
units.literal: Follow the models and canons, bring peace to the four quarters, thereby to preserve heaven’s grace, and do not replace the grand enterprise of our two august predecessors.

units.zh: 帝初以禮讓，魏朝公卿何曾、王沈等固請，乃從之。
units.en: The new sovereign first declined out of courtesy, yet He Zeng, Wang Chen, and the rest of the Wei court insisted until he yielded.
units.literal: At first the emperor demurred on grounds of ritual propriety, but the dukes and ministers of Wei, He Zeng, Wang Chen, and others pressed him firmly, and he then accepted.

units.zh: 泰始元年冬十二月丙寅，設壇于南郊，百僚在位及匈奴南單于四夷會者數萬人，柴燎告類于上帝曰：「皇帝臣炎敢用玄牡明告于皇皇后帝：魏帝稽協皇運，紹天明命以命炎。
units.en: In the first year of Taishi, winter, twelfth month, bingyin, he set up an altar in the southern suburbs. The hundred officials were in position, and the Southern Chanyu of the Xiongnu and assembled chiefs of the four barbarians numbered in the tens of thousands. He burned firewood and reported by class to the High Deity, saying, "The emperor, your servant Yan, dares to use a dark sacrificial bull to announce clearly to the august High Deity: the Wei emperor examined and accorded with the imperial fortune, continued Heaven’s bright command, and used it to command Yan.
units.literal: On the day bingyin, winter, twelfth month, first year of Taishi, he set up an altar south of the suburbs; the hundred officials stood in place, together with the southern chanyu of the Xiongnu and visitors from the four barbarians numbering in the tens of thousands; he kindled the firewood offering and reported the category of his accession to the high lord, saying, "The emperor, your subject Yan, dares to use a black bull clearly to announce to the august sovereign lord: the Wei emperor has examined and aligned with the royal fortune and, clarifying heaven’s bright mandate, has used it to command Yan.

units.zh: 昔者唐堯，熙隆大道，禪位虞舜，舜又以禪禹，邁德垂訓，多歷年載。
units.en: In the past, Tang Yao brightly exalted the great Way and abdicated his position to Yu Shun; Shun in turn abdicated to Yu. Their surpassing virtue left instruction behind and endured through many years.
units.literal: Of old Tang Yao illumined the great way, abdicated the throne to Yu Shun, and Shun again abdicated to Yu, handing down virtue and leaving instructions, through many years.

units.zh: 暨漢德既衰，太祖武皇帝撥亂濟時，扶翼劉氏，又用受命于漢。
units.en: When Han faltered, our martial progenitor quelled disorder and upheld the Liu house, then took his mandate from Han in turn.
units.literal: When Han’s virtue had declined, our first ancestor, the martial emperor, rescued the age from chaos and aided the house of Liu, and again received the mandate from Han.

units.zh: 粵在魏室，仍世多故，幾於顛墜，實賴有晉匡拯之德，用獲保厥肆祀，弘濟于艱難，此則晉之有大造于魏也。
units.en: Under Wei, reign after reign tottered on the brink; only Jin’s rescue allowed the altars to survive—Jin had indeed saved Wei from ruin.
units.literal: As for the house of Wei, generation after generation met many troubles and nearly toppled; truly it relied on Jin’s power of rescue and support to preserve its sacrifices, and broadly to deliver them through hardship—this means that Jin performed a great service for Wei.

units.zh: 誕惟四方，罔不祗順，廓清梁岷，包懷揚越，八紘同軌，祥瑞屢臻，天人協應，無思不服。
units.en: The four quarters submitted; Liang and Min were pacified, Yang and Yue brought within the fold; omens multiplied, heaven and humankind agreed, and none withheld allegiance.
units.literal: Then as for the four quarters, none failed to revere and obey; Liang and Min were cleared, Yang and Yue embraced; the eight cords shared one track, auspicious omens arrived repeatedly, heaven and man responded in concert, and none who thought did not submit.

units.zh: 肆予憲章三后，用集大命于茲。
units.en: So I model myself on the three sage-kings and gather the great mandate in this place.
units.literal: Therefore I take as my model the three later sovereigns and hereby gather the great mandate here.

units.zh: 炎維德不嗣，辭不獲命。
units.en: I, Yan, lack virtue enough to inherit this, yet I cannot refuse what is spoken.
units.literal: I, Yan, in virtue am not heir to my predecessors, yet in words I cannot reject the command.

units.zh: 於是群公卿士，百辟庶僚，黎獻陪隸，暨于百蠻君長，僉曰：『皇天鑒下，求人之瘼，既有成命，固非克讓所得距違。
units.en: Thereupon the assembled dukes, ministers, officers, the hundred nobles and various officials, the common people, attendants and servants, and the chiefs of the hundred barbarians all said: ‘August Heaven looks down and seeks out the people’s suffering. Since there is already a completed mandate, it truly cannot be resisted or rejected by yielding modestly.
units.literal: Thereupon the host of dukes and ministers, the hundred nobles and myriad officials, the commoners and retainers, down to the chiefs of the hundred barbarians, all said, ‘August heaven looks down and seeks out the people’s distress; the completed mandate already exists—indeed it is not something that modest refusal may refuse.’

units.zh: 天序不可以無統，人神不可以曠主。』
units.en: Heaven’s line cannot go without a sovereign; gods and men cannot long be without a master.”
units.literal: The sequence of heaven may not lack a ruler; the gods and men may not long lack a lord.

units.zh: 炎虔奉皇運，寅畏天威，敬簡元辰，升壇受禪，告類上帝，永答眾望。」
units.en: I, Yan, therefore reverence Heaven’s course, choose an auspicious day, mount the altar, receive the abdication, inform the high lord, and answer the hopes of all.”
units.literal: I, Yan, reverently uphold the royal fortune, stand in awe of heaven’s majesty, respectfully choose the primary day, ascend the altar and receive the abdication, report the category to the high lord, and forever answer the multitude’s expectation.

units.zh: 禮畢，即洛陽宮幸太極前殿，詔曰：「昔朕皇祖宣王，聖哲欽明，誕應期運，熙帝之載，肇啟洪基。
units.en: The ceremony done, he entered Luoyang’s Taiji front hall and proclaimed: “My royal grandfather Xuan was a sage who met his age and laid our house’s foundation.
units.literal: When the rites were finished he went at once to the palace at Luoyang and visited the hall before Taiji in the front palace, and issued an edict, saying, "Of old my august grandfather, king Xuan, was sage-like, wise, and discerning; he responded to the period’s fortune and illumined the emperor’s burden, thereby opening the great foundation.

units.zh: 伯考景王，履道宣猷，緝熙諸夏。
units.en: My uncle prince Jing walked in the Way and extended his rule through the central lands.
units.literal: My uncle, prince Jing, walked the way and spread his plans, continuing the brightness among all Xia.

units.zh: 至于皇考文王，叡哲光遠，允協靈祇，應天順時，受茲明命。
units.en: My father king Wen, far-sighted and wise, moved spirits and seasons alike and received the bright mandate.
units.literal: As for my august father, king Wen, profoundly wise and far-seeing, he truly harmonized with the numinous powers, responded to heaven and complied with the season, and received this bright mandate.

units.zh: 仁濟于宇宙，功格于上下。
units.en: His kindness filled the cosmos; his merit spanned heaven and earth.
units.literal: His benevolence reached to the universe; his merit matched heaven and earth.

units.zh: 肆魏氏弘鑒于古訓，儀刑于唐虞，疇咨群后，爰輯大命于朕身。
units.en: So Wei, looking to antiquity like Yao and Shun, consulted the lords and laid the mandate on me.
units.literal: Therefore the house of Wei broadly took mirror from ancient instructions and took law from Tang and Yu, consulted the host of later kings, and thereupon gathered the great mandate upon my person.

units.zh: 予一人畏天之命，用不敢違。
units.en: I stand in awe of Heaven and dare not refuse.
units.literal: I, the solitary man, stand in awe of heaven’s command and therefore dare not disobey.

units.zh: 惟朕寡德，負荷洪烈，託于王公之上，以君臨四海，惴惴惟懼，罔知所濟。
units.en: I am a man of slender merit yet I must bear this vast charge; resting on my nobles I rule all under heaven, anxious and unsure how to succeed.
units.literal: Only I am of scant virtue and bear the mighty enterprise; I rely on the kings and dukes above to face the four seas, trembling in fear, not knowing how to cross.

units.zh: 惟爾股肱爪牙之佐，文武不貳之臣，乃祖乃父，實左右我先王，光隆我大業。
units.en: You who are my ministers—civil and military, loyal as bone and sinew—your fathers aided my forebears and built this great work.
units.literal: Only you, assistants as arms and legs and claws and fangs, ministers civil and military who do not serve two masters, your ancestors and fathers, truly aided our former kings and made radiant our great enterprise.

units.zh: 思與萬國，共享休祚。」
units.en: I mean to share this blessing with every principality.”
units.literal: I desire together with the myriad states to share good fortune.

units.zh: 於是大赦，改元。
units.en: He proclaimed a general amnesty and a new era name.
units.literal: Thereupon he declared a great amnesty and changed the reign title.

units.zh: 賜天下爵，人五級；
units.en: Every household gained five steps in rank.
units.literal: He bestowed noble ranks on the empire, five grades per person;

units.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者穀，人五斛。
units.en: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute received five hu of grain each.
units.literal: To widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless who could not support themselves he gave grain, five hu per person.

units.zh: 復天下租賦及關市之稅一年，逋債宿負皆勿收。
units.en: Land taxes, surcharges, and market dues were forgiven for a year, and old debts were written off.
units.literal: He remitted the empire’s land tax, labor surtax, and market tolls for one year, and long-standing debts and overdue obligations were all not collected.

units.zh: 除舊嫌，解禁錮，亡官失爵者悉復之。
units.en: Old feuds were pardoned, political bans lifted, and everyone stripped of office or title was reinstated.
units.literal: He removed old grudges, lifted prohibitions and exclusions, and all who had lost office or rank were fully restored.

units.zh: 丁卯，遣太僕劉原告于太廟。
units.en: On dingmao he dispatched grand coachman Liu Yuan to report to the imperial temple.
units.literal: On dingmao he sent grand coachman Liu Yuan to announce the matter in the grand temple.

units.zh: 封魏帝爲陳留王，邑萬戶，居於鄴宮；
units.en: The last Wei sovereign became king of Chenliu with a fief of ten thousand households, residing at Ye.
units.literal: He enfeoffed the Wei emperor as king of Chenliu, with ten thousand households, dwelling in the Ye palace;

units.zh: 魏氏諸王皆爲縣侯。
units.en: Every other Wei prince was reduced to county marquis.
units.literal: All kings of the house of Wei were made county marquises.

units.zh: 追尊宣王爲宣皇帝，景王爲景皇帝，文王爲文皇帝，宣王妃張氏爲宣穆皇后。
units.en: He posthumously honored King Xuan as Emperor Xuan, King Jing as Emperor Jing, and King Wen as Emperor Wen, and honored Lady Zhang, consort of King Xuan, as Empress Xuanmu.
units.literal: He posthumously honored king Xuan as emperor Xuan, king Jing as emperor Jing, king Wen as emperor Wen, and king Xuan’s consort, lady Zhang, as empress Xuanmu.

units.zh: 尊太妃王氏曰皇太后，宮曰崇化。
units.en: Lady Wang, the grand consort, became empress dowager with her palace named Chonghua.
units.literal: He honored grand consort Wang as empress dowager, her residence titled Chonghua.

units.zh: 封皇叔祖父孚爲安平王，皇叔父幹爲平原王，亮爲扶風王，伷爲東莞王，駿爲汝陰王，肜爲梁王，倫爲琅邪王，皇弟攸爲齊王，鑒爲樂安王，機爲燕王，[1]皇從伯父望爲義陽王，皇從叔父輔爲渤海王，晃爲下邳王，瑰爲太原王，珪爲高陽王，衡爲常山王，子文爲沛王，[2]泰爲隴西王，權爲彭城王，綏爲范陽王，遂爲濟南王，遜爲譙王，睦爲中山王，陵爲北海王，斌爲陳王，皇從父兄洪爲河間王，皇從父弟楙爲東平王。
units.en: He enfeoffed his granduncle Sima Fu as king of Anping; his uncles Sima Gan as king of Pingyuan, Liang as king of Fufeng, Zhou as king of Dongguan, Jun as king of Ruyin, Tong as king of Liang, and Lun as king of Langye; his younger brother You as king of Qi, Jian as king of Lean, and Ji as king of Yan; [1] his father's elder cousin Wang as king of Yiyang; his father's younger cousins Fu as king of Bohai, Huang as king of Xiapi, Gui as king of Taiyuan, Gui as king of Gaoyang, Heng as king of Changshan, Ziwen as king of Pei, [2] Tai as king of Longxi, Quan as king of Pengcheng, Sui as king of Fanyang, Sui as king of Jinan, Xun as king of Qiao, Mu as king of Zhongshan, Ling as king of Beihai, and Bin as king of Chen; his elder cousin Hong as king of Hejian; and his younger cousin Mao as king of Dongping.
units.literal: He enfeoffed his granduncle Sima Fu as king of Anping, his uncles Sima Gan as king of Pingyuan, Liang as king of Fufeng, Zhou as king of Dongguan, Jun as king of Ru'yin, Tong as king of Liang, Lun as king of Langye, his younger brother You as king of Qi, Jian as king of Le'an, Ji as king of Yan, [1] his cousin once removed Wang as king of Yiyang, his father's younger cousins Fu as king of Bohai, Huang as king of Xiapi, Gui as king of Taiyuan, Gui as king of Gaoyang, Heng as king of Changshan, Ziwen as king of Pei, [2] Tai as king of Longxi, Quan as king of Pengcheng, Sui as king of Fanyang, Sui as king of Jinan, Xun as king of Qiao, Mu as king of Zhongshan, Ling as king of Beihai, and Bin as king of Chen, his cousin Hong as king of Hejian, and his cousin Mao as king of Dongping.

units.zh: 以驃騎將軍石苞爲大司馬，封樂陵公，車騎將軍陳騫爲高平公，衛將軍賈充爲車騎將軍、魯公，尚書令裴秀爲鉅鹿公，侍中荀勖爲濟北公，太保鄭沖爲太傅、壽光公，太尉王祥爲太保、睢陵公，丞相何曾爲太尉、朗陵公，御史大夫王沈爲驃騎將軍、博陵公，司空荀顗爲臨淮公，鎮北大將軍衛瓘爲菑陽公。
units.en: He appointed Shi Bao, general of swift cavalry, grand marshal and duke of Leling; Chen Qian duke of Gaoping; Jia Chong general of chariots and cavalry and duke of Lu; Pei Xiu duke of Julu; Xun Xu duke of Jibei; Zheng Chong grand tutor and duke of Shouguang; Wang Xiang grand guardian and duke of Suiling; He Zeng grand commandant and duke of Langling; Wang Chen general of swift cavalry and duke of Boling; Xun Yi duke of Linhuai; and Wei Guan duke of Ziyang.
units.literal: He appointed Shi Bao, general of swift cavalry, as grand marshal with enfeoffment as duke of Leling; Chen Qian, general of chariots and cavalry, as duke of Gaoping; Jia Chong, guard general, as general of chariots and cavalry and duke of Lu; Pei Xiu, supervisor of the masters of writing, as duke of Julu; Xun Xu, palace attendant, as duke of Jibei; Zheng Chong, grand guardian, as grand tutor and duke of Shouguang; Wang Xiang, grand commandant, as grand protector and duke of Suiling; He Zeng, chancellor, as grand commandant and duke of Langling; Wang Chen, imperial counselor, as general of swift cavalry and duke of Boling; Xun Yi, minister of works, as duke of Linhuai; Wei Guan, great general who guards the north, as duke of Ziyang.

units.zh: 其餘增封進爵各有差，文武普增位二等。
units.en: Others were promoted in title by degrees, and the whole bureaucracy gained two steps in rank.
units.literal: The rest received increased fiefs and advanced noble ranks each according to difference; civil and military officials were universally advanced two grades in rank.

units.zh: 改景初曆爲太始曆，臘以酉，社以丑。
units.en: The calendar was renamed from Jingchu to Taishi; the year-end rite was fixed in you and the soil altar in chou.
units.literal: He changed the Jingchu calendar to the Taishi calendar, with year-end sacrifice in the you hour and earth god in the chou hour.

units.zh: 戊辰，下詔大弘儉約，出御府珠玉玩好之物，頒賜王公以下各有差。
units.en: On wuchen he called for austerity, handing out palace jewels and playthings to princes and nobles by graded gift.
units.literal: On wuchen he issued an edict greatly promoting frugality, bringing out pearls, jade, and curios from the imperial treasury and distributing them to the kings and dukes downward, each according to a scale.

units.zh: 置中軍將軍，以統宿衛七軍。
units.en: He created the post of general of the central army over seven inner garrisons.
units.literal: He established the general of the central army to command the seven palace-guard armies.

units.zh: 己巳，詔陳留王載天子旌旗，備五時副車，行魏正朔，郊祀天地，禮樂制度皆如魏舊，上書不稱臣。
units.en: On jisi the Chenliu king was allowed imperial pennons, five seasonal chariots, Wei’s calendar, full suburban rites, and Wei-style court music, with the privilege that petitioners omit the phrase “your subject.”
units.literal: On jisi he decreed that the king of Chenliu might use the Son of Heaven’s banners, maintain the five seasonal spare chariots, follow Wei’s calendar, sacrifice to heaven and earth, and keep music and ritual as under Wei, while memorials to him need not style the writer a subject.

units.zh: 賜山陽公劉康、安樂公劉禪子弟一人爲駙馬都尉。
units.en: One son or younger kinsman each of Liu Kang, Duke of Shanyang, and Liu Shan, Duke of Anle, was granted the post of Commandant of the Consorts’ Escort.
units.literal: He granted one descendant each of the mountain-yang duke Liu Kang and the duke of peace and ease Liu Shan the post of commandant of the consorts’ escort.

units.zh: 乙亥，以安平王孚爲太宰、假黃鉞、大都督中外諸軍事。
units.en: On yihai Sima Fu, king of Anping, became grand preceptor, bearing the yellow axe as grand commander of all armies.
units.literal: On yihai he appointed king Fu of Anping as grand preceptor, with the yellow axe as credential and grand commander of all military affairs within and without.

units.zh: 詔曰：「昔王淩謀廢齊王，而王竟不足以守位。
units.en: The edict read: “Wang Ling once tried to unseat the prince of Qi, yet Qi still could not hold the throne.
units.literal: The edict said, "Of old Wang Ling plotted to depose the prince of Qi, yet the king in the end proved unable to keep his position.

units.zh: 鄧艾雖矜功失節，然束手受罪。
units.en: Deng Ai, for all his arrogance, surrendered himself for judgment.
units.literal: Deng Ai, though proud of his merit and faulty in restraint, yet bound his hands and accepted punishment.

units.zh: 今大赦其家，還使立後。
units.en: I therefore pardon his household and allow a successor to be named.
units.literal: Now I declare a great amnesty for his family and send orders that an heir be established for him.

units.zh: 興滅繼絕，約法省刑。
units.en: Restore ruined lines, lighten the code, and ease penalties.
units.literal: Raise what was destroyed and continue what was cut off; simplify the laws and lighten punishments.

units.zh: 除魏氏宗室禁錮。
units.en: The Wei imperial clan was freed from house arrest and blacklist.
units.literal: He removed prohibitions and exclusions on the Wei imperial clan.

units.zh: 諸將吏遭三年喪者，遣寧終喪。
units.en: Any official in the three-year mourning for a parent could stay home until the rites were done.
units.literal: For officers and clerks observing the three-year mourning for parents, he allowed them to remain until mourning was finished.

units.zh: 百姓復其傜役。
units.en: Commoners were excused from corvée.
units.literal: The common people had their labor services remitted.

units.zh: 罷部曲將長吏以下質任。
units.en: Hostages once demanded of prefects and lower officers under hereditary generals were ended.
units.literal: He abolished the hostage requirement for commandants and local heads below chief of private troops.

units.zh: 省郡國御調，禁樂府靡麗百戲之伎及雕文游畋之具。
units.en: Commandery “palace” surcharges were dropped, and the music office was barred from lavish shows and carved hunting toys.
units.literal: He cut the court’s special levies on commanderies and principalities, forbade the music bureau’s extravagant acrobatics, and ornamented hunting gear.

units.zh: 開直言之路，置諫官以掌之。」
units.en: He invited frank criticism and set up remonstrators to channel it.”
units.literal: He opened a road for blunt speech and appointed remonstrance officials to manage it."

units.zh: 是月，鳳皇六、青龍三、白龍二、麒麟各一見于郡國。
units.en: That month the registers recorded six phoenix sightings, three azure dragons, two white dragons, and a unicorn across the realm.
units.literal: That month phoenixes appeared six times, azure dragons three times, white dragons twice, and unicorns once in the commanderies and principalities.

units.zh: 二年春正月丙戌，遣兼侍中侯史光等持節四方，循省風俗，除禳祝之不在祀典者。
units.en: In the second year of Taishi, in spring, in the first month, on bingxu, Hou Shiguang and colleagues toured the empire with imperial staffs, removing exorcistic and prayer rites that were not in the ritual canon.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on bingxu he sent concurrent palace attendant Hou Shiguang and others, bearing staffs of authority, to the four directions to tour and inspect customs, and to remove prayers and blessings not listed in the canonical sacrifices.

units.zh: 丁亥，有司請建七廟，帝重其役，不許。
units.en: The ministry asked for seven-temple grandeur; the emperor refused, mindful of the burden.
units.literal: On dinghai the offices requested to build seven ancestral temples; the emperor, weighing the labor, did not grant it.

units.zh: 庚寅，罷雞鳴歌。
units.en: On gengyin he ended the dawn “cock-crow” anthem at court.
units.literal: On gengyin he abolished the “cock-crow” song.

units.zh: 辛丑，尊景皇帝夫人羊氏曰景皇后，宮曰弘訓。
units.en: On xinchou lady Yang, prince Jing’s widow, became empress Jing with palace name Hongxun.
units.literal: On xinchou he honored prince Jing’s consort, lady Yang, as empress Jing, her residence titled Hongxun.

units.zh: 丙午，立皇后楊氏。
units.en: On bingwu he took lady Yang as empress.
units.literal: On bingwu he established lady Yang as empress.

units.zh: 二月，除漢宗室禁錮。
units.en: Second month: surviving Liu-clan nobles were freed from legal disability.
units.literal: In the second month he removed prohibitions and exclusions on Han imperial clansmen.

units.zh: 己未，常山王衡薨。
units.en: On jiwei Sima Heng, king of Changshan, died.
units.literal: On jiwei king Heng of Changshan died.

units.zh: 詔曰：「五等之封，皆錄舊勳。
units.en: The edict said, "The five grades of enfeoffment all record old merit.
units.literal: The edict said, "The enfeoffments of the five ranks all record old merit.

units.zh: 本爲縣侯者傳封次子爲亭侯，鄉侯爲關內侯，[3]亭侯爲關中侯，皆食本戶十分之一。」
units.en: Those who were originally county marquises may transmit an enfeoffment to a second son as a ting marquis; xiang marquises become marquises "inside the passes" [3], and ting marquises become marquises "within Guan," each eating one tenth of the original households."
units.literal: Those who were originally county marquises transmit enfeoffment to a second son as ting marquis, xiang marquises as marquises within the passes, [3] ting marquises as marquises within Guan, each eating one tenth of the original household.

units.zh: 丁丑，[4]郊祀宣皇帝以配天，宗祀文皇帝於明堂以配上帝。
units.en: On dingchou [4] he paired Xuan with Heaven at the southern suburb and Wen with the high lord in the bright hall.
units.literal: On dingchou [4] he sacrificed to heaven at the suburbs with emperor Xuan as correlate, and in the bright hall sacrificed to the high lord with emperor Wen as correlate.

units.zh: 庚午，詔曰：「古者百官，官箴王闕。
units.en: On gengwu, an edict said, "In antiquity, among the hundred officials, each office admonished the king’s deficiencies.
units.literal: On gengwu the edict said, "In antiquity the hundred offices each had maxims for the king’s faults.

units.zh: 然保氏特以諫諍爲職，今之侍中、常侍實處此位。
units.en: The guardian’s special duty was frank advice—now filled by palace and regular attendants.
units.literal: Yet the guardian alone took remonstrance as his duty; today’s palace attendants and regular attendants truly occupy this role.

units.zh: 擇其能正色弼違匡救不逮者，以兼此選。」
units.en: Pick men who will speak truth to power and set them to that very task.”
units.literal: Choose among them those who can correct color and remedy errors and rescue what is lacking, and let them also hold this selection."

units.zh: 三月戊戌，吳人來弔祭，有司奏爲答詔。
units.en: Third month, wuxu: Wu’s envoys arrived for the funeral rites, and the clerks drafted a formal answer.
units.literal: On wuxu of the third month Wu envoys came to offer condolences and sacrifices; the offices memorialized to prepare a reply edict.

units.zh: 帝曰：「昔漢文、光武懷撫尉他、公孫述，皆未正君臣之儀，所以羈縻未賓也。
units.en: The emperor said: “Han Wen and Guangwu treated Zhao Tuo and Gongsun Shu generously without forcing full vassal etiquette—that was how they kept half-independent lords in play.
units.literal: The emperor said, "Of old Han Wen and Guangwu cherished and soothed Zhao Tuo and Gongsun Shu, and never regularized the rites of ruler and subject, thereby to bind those not yet submitted.

units.zh: 皓遣使之始，未知國慶，但以書答之。」
units.en: Sun Hao’s first embassy arrived before he knew we were in mourning; a simple letter sufficed.”
units.literal: When Hao first sent envoys he did not yet know of our state mourning; I answered only with a letter."

units.zh: 夏五月戊辰，詔曰：「陳留王操尚謙沖，每事輒表，非所以優崇之也。
units.en: Summer, fifth month, wuchen: “The Chenliu king still conducts himself with modesty and files a memorial on every trifle—that is no way to honor him.
units.literal: In summer, fifth month, on wuchen the edict said, "The king of Chenliu still conducts himself with modesty and submits a memorial on every matter—this is not the way to show him special honor.

units.zh: 主者喻意，非大事皆使王官表上之。」
units.en: Tell his staff: hereafter routine business should go up through his own officers, not his personal brush, unless it is weighty.”
units.literal: Let the presiding officials make known my intent: except for great matters, have his own officials submit memorials on his behalf."

units.zh: 壬子，[5]驃騎將軍博陵公王沈卒。
units.en: On renzi [5] Wang Chen—swift-cavalry general and duke of Boling—passed away.
units.literal: On the day renzi [5], Wang Chen, general of swift cavalry and duke of Boling, died.

units.zh: 六月壬申，濟南王遂薨。
units.en: In the sixth month, on renshen, Sima Sui, king of Jinan, died.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renshen, king Sui of Jinan died.

units.zh: 秋七月辛巳，營太廟，致荊山之木，采華山之石；
units.en: That autumn, seventh month, xinsi, work began on the great temple, with logs floated from the Jing range and ashlar cut from Mount Hua.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinsi, they built the grand ancestral temple, bringing in timber from Mount Jing and quarrying stone from Mount Hua.

units.zh: 鑄銅柱十二，塗以黃金，鏤以百物，綴以明珠。
units.en: Twelve bronze columns were cast, sheathed in gold, chased with the hundred emblems, and set with brilliant pearls.
units.literal: They cast twelve bronze pillars, gilded them with gold, carved them with images of the myriad things, and studded them with lustrous pearls.

units.zh: 戊戌，譙王遜薨。
units.en: On wuxu the king of Qiao, Sima Xun, died.
units.literal: On the day wuxu, king Xun of Qiao died.

units.zh: 丙午晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: At month’s end, bingwu, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the last day of the month, bingwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 八月丙辰，省右將軍官。
units.en: Eighth month, bingchen: the office of general of the right was struck from the rolls.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingchen, the post of general of the right was abolished.

units.zh: 初，帝雖從漢魏之制，既葬除服，而深衣素冠，降席撤膳，哀敬如喪者。
units.en: Though he had formally left mourning under Han–Wei precedent, he continued to dress plainly, eat simply, and keep the demeanor of a bereaved son.
units.literal: At first, although the emperor followed Han and Wei regulations and doffed mourning after the burial, he wore plain deep garments and an undyed cap, lowered his mat, and withdrew rich foods from his table, grieving with the reverence of one still in mourning.

units.zh: 戊辰，有司奏改服進膳，不許，遂禮終而後復吉。
units.en: Officials begged him on wuchen to set aside austerity; he refused until the last ritual day had passed.
units.literal: On the day wuchen the offices memorialized that he change to normal dress and resume a full diet; he did not grant it, and only when the mourning rites were complete did he return to auspicious observance.

units.zh: 及太后之喪，亦如之。
units.en: At the empress dowager’s death he observed the same severe restraint.
units.literal: When it came to the mourning for the empress dowager, he acted in the same way.

units.zh: 九月乙未，散騎常侍皇甫陶、傅玄領諫官，上書諫諍，有司奏請寢之。
units.en: On yiwei in the ninth month Huangfu Tao and Fu Xuan, as remonstrators, sent up blunt advice; the clerks moved to bury their petitions.
units.literal: On the day yiwei of the ninth month, the regular attendants of cavalier Huangfu Tao and Fu Xuan headed the remonstrance officials and submitted memorials of criticism; the offices memorialized to shelve them.

units.zh: 詔曰：「凡關言人主，人臣所至難，而苦不能聽納，自古忠臣直士之所慷慨也。
units.en: He replied: “Speaking truth to a ruler is the hardest duty a minister bears, and rulers who will not hear it have always broken the hearts of the faithful.
units.literal: An edict said: “In all that touches remonstrating with the sovereign, a subject’s task is hardest of all, yet the bitter inability to listen and accept has stirred loyal ministers and upright men from antiquity onward.

units.zh: 每陳事出付主者，多從深刻，乃云恩貸當由主上，是何言乎？
units.en: Too often papers were passed to clerks who pressed the harshest reading and then claimed mercy was solely the emperor’s affair.
units.literal: Whenever memorials were handed to handlers, they mostly pursued severity; then they would say gracious pardons must come from the throne—what manner of talk is that?

units.zh: 其詳評議。」
units.en: Have every office review this carefully and report.”
units.literal: Let them deliberate this in full detail.”

units.zh: 戊戌，有司奏：「大晉繼三皇之蹤，蹈舜禹之跡，應天順時，受禪有魏，宜一用前代正朔服色，皆如虞遵唐故事。」
units.en: On wuxu, the responsible offices memorialized, "Great Jin follows the traces of the Three August Ones and treads the path of Shun and Yu; it responds to Heaven and follows the times, receiving abdication from Wei. It should uniformly use the former generation’s first month, calendar, and clothing colors, all as Yu followed Tang’s old precedent."
units.literal: On the day wuxu the offices memorialized: “Great Jin treads in the footsteps of the Three Sovereigns, follows the tracks of Shun and Yu, complies with heaven and the times, and received the abdication from Wei; it should uniformly adopt the calendar and regalia of former dynasties, entirely as when Yu followed Tang’s precedent.”

units.zh: 奏可。
units.en: The throne assented.
units.literal: The memorial was approved.

units.zh: 冬十月丙午朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Winter, tenth month, new moon on bingwu: a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day bingwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 丁未，詔曰：「昔舜葬蒼梧，農不易畝；
units.en: On dingwei he cited antiquity: “When Shun lay at Cangwu, no ploughman had to move his furrow.
units.literal: On the day dingwei an edict said: “Of old, when Shun was buried at Cangwu, farmers did not change their fields.

units.zh: 禹葬成紀，市不改肆。
units.en: When Yu rested at Chengji, shopkeepers kept the same stalls.
units.literal: When Yu was buried at Chengji, markets did not change their stalls.

units.zh: 上惟祖考清簡之旨，所徙陵十里內居人，動爲煩擾，一切停之。」
units.en: Mindful of my forebears’ love of simplicity, I stop every plan to uproot households within ten li of the imperial tombs.”
units.literal: Reflecting on the clear and simple intent of my ancestors, the removal of commoners dwelling within ten li of the mausoleum sites would stir needless trouble; all such relocations are halted.”

units.zh: 十一月己卯，倭人來獻方物。
units.en: Eleventh month, jimao: envoys from Wa arrived with tribute.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jimao, people of Wa came to present local products.

units.zh: 并圜丘、方丘於南、北郊，二至之祀合於二郊。
units.en: Suburban ritual was streamlined: the round and square altars were paired with south and north suburb worship, and the solstice services were folded into those sites.
units.literal: The Round Mound and Square Mound were combined at the southern and northern suburban altars; the two solstice sacrifices were united with those two suburban rites.

units.zh: 罷山陽公國督軍，除其禁制。
units.en: The military overseer attached to the mountain-yang ducal fief was dismissed and its special prohibitions lifted.
units.literal: The supervisory army of the mountain-yang duke’s state was abolished and its restrictive controls removed.

units.zh: 己丑，追尊景帝夫人夏侯氏爲景懷皇后。
units.en: On jichou Xiahou, prince Jing’s widow, was canonized as empress Jinghuai.
units.literal: On the day jichou prince Jing’s consort, the lady of the Xiahou clan, was posthumously honored as empress Jinghuai.

units.zh: 辛卯，遷祖禰神主于太廟。
units.en: On xinmao the ancestral tablets were carried into the great temple.
units.literal: On the day xinmao the spirit tablets of the distant and immediate ancestors were moved into the grand temple.

units.zh: 十二月，罷農官爲郡縣。
units.en: In the twelfth month the old “agriculture” jurisdictions were converted into ordinary counties.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the agricultural intendancies were abolished and reorganized as commanderies and counties.

units.zh: 是歲，鳳皇六、青龍十、黃龍九、麒麟各一見于郡國。
units.en: The year’s omens included six phoenixes, ten azure dragons, nine yellow dragons, and a unicorn reported across the realm.
units.literal: That year phoenixes appeared six times, azure dragons ten times, yellow dragons nine times, and a unicorn once in the commanderies and principalities.

units.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，白龍二見于弘農、澠池。
units.en: the third year of Taishi, spring, guichou: twin white dragons were sighted at Hongnong and Mianchi.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day guichou, two white dragons were seen at Hongnong and Mianchi.

units.zh: 丁卯，[6]立皇子衷爲皇太子。
units.en: On dingmao [6] Sima Zhong was named heir apparent.
units.literal: On the day dingmao [6] the imperial son Zhong was established as crown prince.

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以不德，託于四海之上，兢兢祗畏，懼無以康濟宇內，思與天下式明王度，正本清源，於置胤樹嫡，非所先務。
units.en: The edict said: “I, lacking virtue, have been entrusted with a place above the four seas. Anxious and reverent, I fear I have no means to bring peace and rescue to all within the realm, and I wish together with all under Heaven to make clear the royal standards, rectify the root, and clear the source. As for establishing an heir and setting up the legitimate line, that is not the first task.
units.literal: An edict said: “I, lacking in virtue, rely on the realm above me; fearful and reverent, I worry that I cannot bring peace within the four seas, and I wish together with all under heaven to clarify the kingly norms, rectify the root and cleanse the source; as for establishing heirs and fixing the legitimate line, that is not the foremost task at present.

units.zh: 又近世每建太子，寬宥施惠之事，間不獲已，順從王公卿士之議耳。
units.en: Lately each new heir brought wholesale amnesties—measures taken only when ministers pressed for them, not because they were inherently right.
units.literal: Moreover in recent times, whenever a crown prince was installed, the granting of broad pardons and largesse was only an occasional necessity, done to comply with the opinions of kings, dukes, and ministers.

units.zh: 方今世運垂平，將陳之以德義，示之以好惡，使百姓蠲多幸之慮，篤終始之行，曲惠小仁，故無取焉。
units.en: As peace nears, I would teach the realm through moral example rather than scatter small mercies that teach the crowd to gamble on fortune.
units.literal: Now the age’s fortune verges on peace; I shall set forth virtue and duty, show good and evil plainly, so that the people may cast off vain hopes of luck and devote themselves to conduct from first to last; petty favors dressed as kindness are therefore not to be adopted.

units.zh: 咸使知聞。」
units.en: Let everyone hear and understand this.”
units.literal: Let all be informed of this.”

units.zh: 三月戊寅，初令二千石得終三年喪。
units.en: Third month, wuyin: for the first time, governors at the two-thousand-picul grade were allowed the full three-year funeral for a parent.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, it was first ordered that officials at two thousand piculs might observe the full three-year mourning for parents.

units.zh: 丁未，晝昏。
units.en: On dingwei daylight failed at noon.
units.literal: On the day dingwei it was dark at midday.

units.zh: 罷武衛將軍官。
units.en: The “martial guard” generalship was eliminated.
units.literal: The post of general who guards the martial guard was abolished.

units.zh: 以李憙爲太子太傅。
units.en: Li Xi became tutor to the heir.
units.literal: Li Xi was appointed grand tutor to the crown prince.

units.zh: 太山石崩。
units.en: A cliff face on Mount Tai fell in a landslide.
units.literal: Mount Tai’s stone cliffs collapsed.

units.zh: 夏四月戊午，張掖太守焦勝上言，氐池縣大柳谷口有玄石一所，白畫成文，實大晉之休祥，圖之以獻。
units.en: Summer, fourth month, wuwu: Jiao Sheng of Zhangye sent up word that a black boulder in Dichi’s Great Willow Gorge had sprouted white-inscribed text—a Jin omen—and enclosed a rubbing.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuwu, Zhangye prefect Jiao Sheng reported that at the mouth of Great Willow Valley in Dichi county there was a black stone on which characters formed in daylight, truly an auspicious sign for great Jin; he had it drawn and presented.

units.zh: 詔以制幣告于太廟，藏之天府。
units.en: The court acknowledged the omen with ritual silks at the great temple and locked the stone away in the imperial archive.
units.literal: An edict ordered silks and jade disks to be used in announcement at the grand temple, and the object stored in the celestial treasury.

units.zh: 秋八月，罷都護將軍，以其五署還光祿勳。
units.en: Autumn, eighth month: the “protect all armies” post was cut, its five offices folded back under the superintendent of palace gentlemen.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, the general who protects all armies was abolished, and its five bureaus were returned to the superintendent of the palace gentlemen.

units.zh: 九月甲申，詔曰：「古者以德詔爵，以庸制祿，雖下士猶食上農，外足以奉公忘私，內足以養親施惠。
units.en: In the ninth month, jiashen, an edict said, "In antiquity, rank was commanded according to virtue and salary fixed according to service; even lower shi still ate at the level of upper farmers, outwardly enough to serve the public and forget private interest, inwardly enough to support kin and extend kindness.
units.literal: On the day jiashen of the ninth month an edict said: “In antiquity ranks were proclaimed by virtue, stipends regulated by service; even a low knight still ate like a top farmer, outwardly enough to serve the state and forget private interest, inwardly enough to nourish kin and spread kindness.

units.zh: 今在位者祿不代耕，非所以崇化之本也。
units.en: Today’s salaries no longer match a farmer’s harvest—that is a poor way to teach honest government.
units.literal: Now those in office receive stipends that do not equal the yield of ploughing; this is not the root of promoting transformation.

units.zh: 其議增吏俸。」
units.en: He ordered a discussion of higher pay for officials.”
units.literal: Let them deliberate increasing clerks’ salaries.”

units.zh: 賜王公以下帛各有差。
units.en: Silk gifts went out to every rank from princes downward, graded by station.
units.literal: Silks were bestowed on the kings and dukes downward, each according to a scale.”

units.zh: 以太尉何曾爲太保，義陽王望爲太尉，司空荀顗爲司徒。
units.en: He Zeng, Grand Commandant, was made Grand Guardian; Wang, King of Yiyang, was made Grand Commandant; and Xun Yi, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: Grand commandant He Zeng was made grand protector; king Wang of Yiyang was made grand commandant; minister of works Xun Yi was made steward of the masters of the people.

units.zh: 冬十月，聽士卒遭父母喪者，非在疆埸，皆得奔赴。
units.en: Winter, tenth month: troops mourning parents could leave camp for the funeral unless they stood on an active frontier.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, soldiers whose parents had died were permitted to hurry home for mourning unless they were on the battlefront.

units.zh: 十二月，徙宗聖侯孔震爲奉聖亭侯。
units.en: In the twelfth month: Kong Zhen, “continuer of the sage,” was moved to the smaller fief of “village that honors the sage.”
units.literal: In the twelfth month the marquis who continues the sage, Kong Zhen, was transferred to be marquis of the village that honors the sage.

units.zh: 山陽公劉康來朝。
units.en: Liu Kang, the mountain-yang duke, paid a formal visit.
units.literal: The mountain-yang duke Liu Kang came to court.

units.zh: 禁星氣讖緯之學。
units.en: Astrology, prophecy, and apocryphal “weft” learning were banned.
units.literal: The study of stellar omens, prognostication, and weft-text apocrypha was forbidden.

units.zh: 四年春正月辛未，以尚書令裴秀爲司空。
units.en: Fourth year, spring, xinwei: Pei Xiu left the secretariat to become minister of works.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day xinwei, Pei Xiu, supervisor of the masters of writing, was appointed minister of works.

units.zh: 丙戌，律令成，封爵賜帛各有差。
units.en: On bingxu the new code was finished; titles and silk were handed out by grade.
units.literal: On the day bingxu the code and ordinances were completed; enfeoffments and silk gifts were distributed each according to difference.

units.zh: 有星孛于軫。
units.en: A comet blazed across the Zhen mansion in the sky.
units.literal: A broom star appeared in the asterism Zhen.

units.zh: 丁亥，帝耕於藉田。
units.en: On dinghai the Son of Heaven broke the soil of the ritual field.
units.literal: On the day dinghai the emperor ploughed the sacred field.

units.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「古設象刑而眾不犯，今雖參夷而姦不絕，何德刑相去之遠哉！
units.en: On wuzi he mused: “When the ancients set up symbolic punishments, the multitude did not offend; today we slaughter whole clans yet treason persists—what has become of moral government?
units.literal: On the day wuzi an edict said: “In antiquity symbolic punishments were set up yet the multitude did not offend; now though we extend punishment to three kinships wickedness does not cease—how far apart are virtue and punishment!

units.zh: 先帝深愍黎元，哀矜庶獄，乃命群后，考正典刑。
units.en: My predecessor pitied the commoners and bade his ministers revise the penal code with mercy.
units.literal: The former emperor deeply pitied the black-haired people and showed compassion in the myriad cases of justice; he therefore ordered the host of later kings to examine and correct the canonical punishments.

units.zh: 朕守遺業，永惟保乂皇基，思與萬國以無爲爲政。
units.en: I hold his legacy and mean to secure the throne through quiet, sparing rule.
units.literal: I guard the inherited enterprise and ever think to protect and stabilize the royal foundation; I desire together with the myriad regions to govern by non-action.

units.zh: 方今陽春養物，東作始興，朕親率王公卿士耕藉田千畝。
units.en: Now, in bright spring, when things are nourished and eastern labors are just beginning, I have personally led the kings, dukes, ministers, and officers in ploughing one thousand mu of the imperial field.
units.literal: Now, in the yang spring that nurtures things, eastern works are just beginning; I have personally led kings, dukes, and ministers to plough one thousand mu of the sacred field.

units.zh: 又律令既就，班之天下，將以簡法務本，惠育海內。
units.en: The finished statutes will go to every commandery to streamline justice and nurture the people.
units.literal: Moreover, now that the code and ordinances are ready, they will be promulgated to the empire in order to simplify the laws and stress fundamentals, thereby kindly nurturing all within the seas.

units.zh: 宜寬有罪，使得自新，其大赦天下。
units.en: A general amnesty will let minor offenders begin again.
units.literal: It is fitting to widen mercy to the guilty so they may renew themselves; therefore a great amnesty is declared for the realm.

units.zh: 長吏、郡丞、長史各賜馬一匹。」
units.en: Every prefect, aide, and senior clerk receives a horse from the stable.”
units.literal: Each chief, assistant, and senior clerk is granted one horse.”

units.zh: 二月庚子，增置山陽公國相、郎中令、陵令、雜工宰人、鼓吹車馬各有差。
units.en: Second month, gengzi: the Shanyang duke’s state gained a full household staff—chancellor, household director, tomb wardens, artisans, cooks, and a band with carriages.
units.literal: On the day gengzi of the second month posts were added to the mountain-yang duke’s state—a minister, a gentleman director, a tomb intendant, miscellaneous artisans, cooks, and musical ensembles and carriages, each according to scale.

units.zh: 罷中軍將軍，置北軍中候官。
units.en: The central-army command was deleted in favor of a northern-army inspector.
units.literal: The general of the central army was abolished and the post of inspector of the northern armies was established.

units.zh: 甲寅，以東海劉儉有至行，拜爲郎。
units.en: On jiayin Liu Jian of Donghai, famed for virtue, was named a court gentleman.
units.literal: On the day jiayin Liu Jian of Donghai, for supreme conduct, was appointed gentleman.

units.zh: 以中軍將軍羊祜爲尚書左僕射，東莞王伷爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Yang Hu became left vice-president of the secretariat; Sima Zhou of Dongguan became right vice-president.
units.literal: General of the central army Yang Hu was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left; king Zhou of Dongguan was appointed senior vice-director of the right.

units.zh: 三月戊子，皇太后王氏崩。
units.en: Third month, wuzi: Empress Dowager Wang passed away.
units.literal: On the day wuzi of the third month Empress Dowager Wang died.

units.zh: 夏四月戊戌，太保、睢陵公王祥薨。
units.en: Summer, fourth month, wuxu: Wang Xiang, grand protector of Suiling, died.
units.literal: On the day wuxu of summer, fourth month, Wang Xiang, grand protector and duke of Suiling, died.

units.zh: 己亥，祔葬文明皇后王氏於崇陽陵。
units.en: On jihai Empress Wenming was laid beside her husband at Chongyang.
units.literal: On the day jihai Empress Wenming, lady Wang, was given joint burial at Chongyang mausoleum.

units.zh: 罷振威、揚威護軍官，置左右積弩將軍。
units.en: The “display might” and “raise might” protector posts were cut; left and right “accumulated crossbow” generals took their place.
units.literal: The posts of protector generals who display might and raise might were abolished, and generals of the left and right accumulated crossbows were established.

units.zh: 六月丙申朔，[8]詔曰：「郡國守相，三載一巡行屬縣，必以春，此古者所以述職宣風展義也。
units.en: Sixth month, new moon, bingshen [8]: an edict said, "Commandery and principality governors and chiefs shall once every three years tour their subordinate counties, necessarily in spring. This is how antiquity required them to report duty, spread customs, and display righteousness.
units.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, bingshen [8], an edict said: “Commandery and principality governors and chiefs shall once every three years tour their subordinate counties, necessarily in spring—this is how antiquity required them to report duty, spread customs, and display righteousness.

units.zh: 見長吏，觀風俗，協禮律，考度量，存問耆老，親見百年。
units.en: They are to meet with senior officials, observe local customs, harmonize rites and statutes, check weights and measures, inquire after the elders, and personally visit those who have reached one hundred years.
units.literal: They shall meet county chiefs, observe local customs, harmonize ritual with law, examine weights and measures, inquire after the aged, and personally visit centenarians.

units.zh: 錄囚徒，理冤枉，詳察政刑得失，知百姓所患苦。
units.en: They must review dockets, reverse injustice, weigh the quality of justice, and learn what pains the people.
units.literal: They shall record prisoners, rectify wrongful judgments, and carefully review whether administration and punishments gain or lose, and know what troubles the hundred surnames.

units.zh: 無有遠近，便若朕親臨之。
units.en: Distance must not blunt inspection; each tour should feel like an imperial visit.
units.literal: Whether near or far, it shall be as if I myself were present.

units.zh: 敦喻五教，勸務農功，勉勵學者，思勤正典，無爲百家庸末，致遠必泥。
units.en: They should preach the five relationships, push farming, urge scholars toward the orthodox canon, and shun the hundred schools’ pedantry.
units.literal: They shall earnestly expound the five teachings, urge agricultural work, encourage students to labor at the correct classics, and not become vulgar pedants of the hundred schools who stick in the mud when seeking what is distant.

units.zh: 士庶有好學篤道，孝弟忠信，清白異行者，舉而進之；
units.en: Promote any commoner or gentleman who studies deeply, keeps filial piety and good faith, and lives with conspicuous integrity.
units.literal: For gentry and commoners who love learning, cleave to the way, are filial, fraternal, loyal, and faithful, and show unsullied conduct out of the ordinary, recommend and advance them.

units.zh: 有不孝敬於父母，不長悌於族黨，悖禮棄常，不率法令者，糾而罪之。
units.en: Punish unfilial kin, clan troublemakers, and lawbreakers.
units.literal: Those who fail to show filial respect to parents or senior kindness within the lineage, who violate ritual and abandon constant norms, or who do not obey statutes and orders, investigate and punish them.

units.zh: 田疇闢，生業修，禮教設，禁令行，則長吏之能也。
units.en: Good magistrates open land, enrich households, teach ritual, and enforce the code.
units.literal: When fields are opened, livelihoods improved, ritual instruction established, and prohibitions enforced—that is the ability of a chief.

units.zh: 人窮匱，農事荒，姦盜起，刑獄煩，下陵上替，禮義不興，斯長吏之否也。
units.en: Bad ones leave fields idle, invite theft, clog the courts, and let propriety collapse.
units.literal: When people are destitute, farming neglected, banditry rises, litigation piles up, inferiors bully superiors, and ritual and rightness do not flourish—that is the failure of a chief.

units.zh: 若長吏在官公廉，慮不及私，正色直節，不飾名譽者，及身行貪穢，諂黷求容，公節不立，而私門日富者，並謹察之。
units.en: If senior officials in office are fair and incorrupt, do not let their thoughts reach private interest, keep a stern bearing and straight integrity, and do not embellish their reputation, or if they personally act with greed and corruption, flatter and bribe to seek favor, fail to establish public integrity, and grow richer by the day at their private gates, both types are to be carefully examined.
units.literal: If a chief in office is fair and incorrupt, his thoughts do not turn to private gain, his bearing is straight and his integrity unbending, and he does not polish reputation; or if personally he walks the path of greed and filth, flatters and bribes to win favor, public integrity is not set up while private gates grow daily richer—both sorts shall be carefully examined.

units.zh: 揚清激濁，舉善彈違，此朕所以垂拱總綱，責成於良二千石也。
units.en: That is how I mean to clarify administration from the capital while counting on strong two-thousand-picul men in the provinces.
units.literal: To raise the clear and stir the turbid, to recommend the good and impeach the deviant—this is why I sit with folded arms holding the net’s cords and entrust completion to worthy governors at two thousand piculs.

units.zh: 於戲戒哉！」
units.en: Take this order to heart.”
units.literal: Oh! Be vigilant!”

units.zh: 秋七月，太山石崩，眾星西流。
units.en: Seventh month: another cliff fell on Mount Tai while meteors streaked west across the sky.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Mount Tai’s stone collapsed and hosts of stars streamed westward.

units.zh: 戊午，[9]遣使者侯史光循行天下。
units.en: On wuwu [9] Hou Shiguang and other inspectors fanned out across the realm.
units.literal: On the day wuwu [9] envoys led by Hou Shiguang were sent to tour the empire.

units.zh: 己卯，謁崇陽陵。
units.en: On jimao the emperor paid his respects at Chongyang tomb.
units.literal: On the day jimao he visited Chongyang mausoleum.

units.zh: 九月，青、徐、兗、豫四州大水，伊洛溢，合於河，開倉以振之。
units.en: Ninth month: Qing, Xu, Yan, and Yu provinces suffered great floods. The Yi and Luo overflowed and joined the River, and the granaries were opened for relief.
units.literal: In the ninth month the four provinces Qing, Xu, Yan, and Yu suffered great floods; the Yi and Luo overflowed and merged with the Yellow River; granaries were opened for relief.

units.zh: 詔曰：「雖詔有所欲，及奏得可而於事不便者，皆不可隱情。」
units.en: An edict said, "Even when an edict has what it desires, and when a memorial obtains approval, if the matter is inconvenient in practice, no one may conceal the facts."
units.literal: An edict said: “Although an edict may express what is desired, and although a memorial may be approved, if the matter is inconvenient in practice, none may hide the true situation.”

units.zh: 冬十月，吳將施績入江夏，萬郁寇襄陽。
units.en: Winter, tenth month: Wu’s Shi Ji pushed into Jiangxia while Wan Yu struck Xiangyang.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Wu general Shi Ji entered Jiangxia, and Wan Yu raided Xiangyang.

units.zh: [10]遣太尉義陽王望屯龍陂。
units.en: [10] Grand commandant Sima Wang of Yiyang marched to Longpi.
units.literal: [10] Grand commandant Sima Wang of Yiyang was sent to encamp at Longpi.

units.zh: 荊州刺史胡烈擊敗郁。
units.en: Hu Lie, inspector of Jing, routed Wan Yu.
units.literal: Jing province inspector Hu Lie defeated Wan Yu.

units.zh: 吳將顧容寇鬱林，太守毛炅大破之，斬其交州刺史劉俊、將軍修則。
units.en: Gu Rong of Wu invaded Yulin; Mao Jiong shattered his army and took the heads of Jiao inspector Liu Jun and general Xiu Ze.
units.literal: Wu general Gu Rong raided Yulin; prefect Mao Jiong crushed him, beheading Wu’s inspector of Jiao, Liu Jun, and general Xiu Ze.

units.zh: 十一月，吳將丁奉等出芍陂，安東將軍汝陰王駿與義陽王望擊走之。
units.en: Eleventh month: Ding Feng led Wu forces out of Quepi; Sima Jun and Sima Wang threw them back.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Wu generals including Ding Feng came out from Quepi; general who guards the east Sima Jun, king of Ru'yin, together with Sima Wang of Yiyang, drove them off.

units.zh: 己未，詔王公卿尹及郡國守相，舉賢良方正直言之士。
units.en: On jiwei he called for nominations of worthy, honest, outspoken talent from every princely house and province.
units.literal: On the day jiwei an edict ordered kings, dukes, chief ministers, and commandery and principality governors and chiefs to recommend men worthy, good, and upright who spoke plainly.

units.zh: 十二月，班五條詔書於郡國：一曰正身，二曰勤百姓，三曰撫孤寡，四曰敦本息末，五曰去人事。
units.en: The twelfth month brought the five-point provincial charter—self-cultivation, care for the people, relief for the helpless, agriculture over commerce, and an end to clientage.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the five-article edict was promulgated to commanderies and principalities: first, rectify oneself; second, diligently care for the hundred surnames; third, soothe widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; fourth, stress the root and restrain the tip; fifth, remove private networking.

units.zh: 庚寅，帝臨聽訟觀，錄廷尉洛陽獄囚，親平決焉。
units.en: On gengyin he sat in the Luoyang review court and personally cleared the capital jail.
units.literal: On the day gengyin the emperor attended the hall for hearing lawsuits, reviewed the prisoners of the commandant of justice at Luoyang, and personally settled their cases.

units.zh: 扶南、林邑各遣使來獻。
units.en: Funan and Lin-yi both dispatched embassies with gifts.
units.literal: Funan and Lin-yi each sent envoys to present tribute.

units.zh: 五年春正月癸巳，申戒郡國計吏守相令長，務盡地利，禁游食商販。
units.en: Fifth year, spring, guisi: account clerks and magistrates were warned to fill every acre and ban idle hawkers.
units.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day guisi, he sternly admonished the commandery accounting clerks, governors, and chiefs to exhaust the advantages of the soil and forbid vagrant peddlers.

units.zh: 丙申，帝臨聽訟觀錄囚徒，多所原遣。
units.en: On bingshen he heard capital cases again and freed a large number.
units.literal: On the day bingshen the emperor attended the hall for hearing lawsuits, reviewed prisoners, and many were pardoned or released.

units.zh: 青龍二見於滎陽。
units.en: Twin azure dragons were reported at Xingyang.
units.literal: Two azure dragons appeared at Xingyang.

units.zh: 二月，以雍州隴右五郡及涼州之金城、梁州之陰平置秦州。
units.en: In the second month he carved out Qin province, combining the five Longyou commanderies under Yong with Jincheng from the Hexi frontier and Yinping from the Hanzhong basin.
units.literal: In the second month Qin province was established from the five commanderies of Yongzhou west of the Long Range, together with Jincheng commandery from the northwest frontier and Yinping commandery from the Hanzhong uplands.

units.zh: 辛巳，白龍二見於趙國。
units.en: On xinsi two white dragons appeared in Zhao.
units.literal: On the day xinsi two white dragons were seen in the principality of Zhao.

units.zh: 青、徐、兗三州水，遣使振恤之。
units.en: Flooding struck Qing, Xu, and Yan; the court dispatched inspectors with grain and aid.
units.literal: The provinces of Qing, Xu, and Yan suffered floods; envoys were sent to relieve them.

units.zh: 壬寅，以尚書左僕射羊祜都督荊州諸軍事，征東大將軍衛瓘都督青州諸軍事，東莞王伷鎮東大將軍、都督徐州諸軍事。
units.en: On renyin Yang Hu took command on the Jing front, Wei Guan on the Qing front, and Sima Zhou of Dongguan became commander-in-chief on the Xu front.
units.literal: On the day renyin, Yang Hu, senior vice-director of the masters of the left, was appointed to supervise all military affairs of Jing province; Wei Guan, great general who campaigns east, was appointed to supervise all military affairs of Qing province; king Zhou of Dongguan was made great general who guards the east and supervisor of all military affairs of Xu province.

units.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「古者歲書群吏之能否，三年而誅賞之。
units.en: On dinghai, an edict said, "In antiquity, each year the ability or inability of the assembled clerks was written down, and after three years they were punished or rewarded.
units.literal: On the day dinghai an edict said: “In antiquity the year’s record set down whether host of clerks could or could not perform their duties; after three years they were executed or rewarded.

units.zh: 諸令史前後，但簡遣疏劣，而無有勸進，非黜陟之謂也。
units.en: So far prefects had only purged the useless without promoting the able—that was not true evaluation.
units.literal: Among the clerks of the various prefectures, hitherto only the slack and inferior were winnowed out and dismissed, while there was no encouragement of advancement—this is not what demotion and promotion mean.

units.zh: 其條勤能有稱尤異者，歲以爲常。
units.en: Any clerk praised year after year for diligence and talent should be entered on a standing honor roll.
units.literal: Let those whose diligence and ability win praise as outstanding be recorded annually as a constant rule.

units.zh: 吾將議其功勞。」
units.en: The throne will then weigh rewards for proven service.”
units.literal: I shall deliberate their merit and labor.”

units.zh: 己未，詔蜀相諸葛亮孫京隨才署吏。
units.en: On jiwei, Zhuge Liang's grandson Zhuge Jing was assigned an office suited to his talents.
units.literal: On jiwei, an edict ordered that Zhuge Jing, grandson of Zhuge Liang, chancellor of Shu, be appointed to office according to his abilities.

units.zh: 夏四月，地震。
units.en: Summer, fourth month: the earth shook.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 五月辛卯朔，鳳皇見于趙國。
units.en: Fifth month began on xinmao with a phoenix sighting in Zhao.
units.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, xinmao, a phoenix was seen in the principality of Zhao.

units.zh: 曲赦交趾、九真、日南五歲刑。
units.en: A partial amnesty remitted sentences of five years in Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, and Rinan.
units.literal: A partial amnesty remitted five years of penal labor in Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, and Rinan.

units.zh: 六月，鄴奚官督郭廙上疏陳五事以諫，言甚切直，擢爲屯留令。
units.en: A Ye workshop overseer named Guo Yi sent up a blunt five-point memorial and was rewarded with the Tunliu magistracy.
units.literal: In the sixth month Guo Yi, overseer of Ye’s “Xi” artisans, submitted a memorial stating five points of remonstrance in very blunt terms; he was promoted to magistrate of Tunliu.

units.zh: 西平人麴路伐登聞鼓，言多祅謗，有司奏棄市。
units.en: Qu Lu of Xiping pounded the appeal drum with wild, slanderous talk; the ministry sought a public execution.
units.literal: A man of Xiping, Qu Lu, beat the drum for hearing grievances and spoke much slanderous prophecy; the offices memorialized to execute him in the marketplace.

units.zh: 帝曰：「朕之過也。」
units.en: The emperor answered, “The fault is mine.”
units.literal: The emperor said: “This is my fault.”

units.zh: 捨而不問。
units.en: He let the man go without punishment.
units.literal: He released Qu Lu and made no further inquiry.

units.zh: 罷鎮軍將軍，復置左右將軍官。
units.en: The “guard the army” command was cut while left and right generals returned to the table of organization.
units.literal: The general who guards the army was abolished, and posts of generals of the left and right were restored.

units.zh: 秋七月，延群公，詢讜言。
units.en: Seventh month: he convened the great nobles and asked for plain speech.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, he extended audience to the host of dukes and sought out candid counsel.

units.zh: 九月，有星孛于紫宮。
units.en: Ninth month: a comet blazed through the circumpolar palace.
units.literal: In the ninth month a broom star appeared in the Purple Palace constellation.

units.zh: 冬十月丙子，以汲郡太守王宏有政績，賜穀千斛。
units.en: Winter, tenth month, bingzi: Wang Hong of Ji won a thousand-hu bounty for good governance.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingzi, because Wang Hong, prefect of Ji commandery, had administrative achievements, he was granted one thousand hu of grain.

units.zh: 十一月，追封諡皇弟兆爲城陽哀王，以皇子景度嗣。
units.en: November canonized the late prince Zhao as king Ai of Chengyang and installed Prince Jingdu in his line.
units.literal: In the eleventh month he posthumously enfeoffed and gave a posthumous name to the imperial younger brother Zhao as king Ai of Chengyang, and the imperial son Jingdu succeeded him.

units.zh: 十二月，詔州郡舉勇猛秀異之才。
units.en: In the twelfth month: every province was told to nominate bold and exceptional warriors.
units.literal: In the twelfth month he ordered commanderies and provinces to recommend men brave, fierce, and outstanding in talent.

units.zh: 六年春正月丁亥朔，帝臨軒，不設樂。
units.en: the sixth year of Taishi, new year on dinghai: he held court in the gallery without music.
units.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the first day dinghai, the emperor came to the gallery; music was not performed.

units.zh: 吳將丁奉入渦口，揚州刺史牽弘擊走之。
units.en: Ding Feng of Wu probed the Wo estuary until Qian Hong, Yang’s inspector, threw him back.
units.literal: Wu general Ding Feng entered the mouth of the Wo River; Qian Hong, inspector of Yang province, attacked and drove him off.

units.zh: 三月，赦五歲刑已下。
units.en: Third month: sentences of five years or less were forgiven.
units.literal: In the third month he pardoned penal labor up to five years.

units.zh: 夏四月，白龍二見於東莞。
units.en: Summer: twin white dragons were reported in Dongguan.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, two white dragons were seen at Dongguan.

units.zh: 五月，立壽安亭侯承爲南宮王。
units.en: In the fifth month he raised marquis Cheng of Shou'an village to king of the southern palace.
units.literal: In the fifth month he established Cheng, marquis of the village of Shou'an, as king of the southern palace.

units.zh: 六月戊午，秦州刺史胡烈擊叛虜於萬斛堆，力戰，死之。
units.en: Sixth month, wuwu: Hu Lie died charging tribal rebels at Wanhudui.
units.literal: On the day wuwu of the sixth month, Hu Lie, inspector of Qin province, attacked mutinous tribesmen at Wanhudui, fought hard, and died in battle.

units.zh: 詔遣尚書石鑒行安西將軍、都督秦州諸軍事，與奮威護軍田章討之。
units.en: An edict sent Shi Jian of the Secretariat to act as General Who Pacifies the West and area commander-in-chief for all military affairs in Qin province, and to campaign against them together with Tian Zhang, protector-general Who Displays Might.
units.literal: An edict dispatched supervisor of the masters of writing Shi Jian to act as general who pacifies the west and supervise all military affairs of Qin province, together with protector general who displays might Tian Zhang to campaign against them.

units.zh: 秋七月丁酉，復隴右五郡遇寇害者租賦，不能自存者廩貸之。
units.en: Seventh month, dingyou: the five Longyou counties ravaged by raiders were tax-free, and starving households got grain loans.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dingyou, land tax and labor surtax were remitted for the five Longyou commanderies that had suffered bandit harm, and those unable to support themselves were loaned grain from the granaries.

units.zh: 乙巳，城陽王景度薨。
units.en: On yisi the young king of Chengyang, Jingdu, died.
units.literal: On the day yisi king Jingdu of Chengyang died.

units.zh: 詔曰：「自泰始以來，大事皆撰錄祕書，寫副。
units.en: An edict said, "Since Taishi, all major affairs have been compiled and recorded in the Secretariat archive, with copies written.
units.literal: An edict said: “Since Taishi, great affairs have all been compiled in the secretariat with duplicate copies written.

units.zh: 後有其事，輒宜綴集以爲常。」
units.en: Future events of the same weight must be added to the dossier as routine.”
units.literal: Whenever later there is such an affair, it should at once be appended and gathered as a constant practice.”

units.zh: 丁未，以汝陰王駿爲鎮西大將軍、都督雍涼二州諸軍事。
units.en: On dingwei Sima Jun of Ru'yin became western commander over Yong and Liang.
units.literal: On the day dingwei king Jun of Ru'yin was made great general who guards the west and supervisor of all military affairs of Yong and Liang provinces.

units.zh: 九月，大宛獻汗血馬，焉耆來貢方物。
units.en: Ninth month: Ferghana sent blood-sweating steeds; Yanqi sent envoys with gifts.
units.literal: In the ninth month Ferghana presented sweat-blood horses, and Yanqi came to offer local tribute.

units.zh: 冬十一月，幸辟雍，行鄉飲酒之禮，賜太常博士、學生帛牛酒各有差。
units.en: Winter, eleventh month: at the imperial academy he held the archery feast and handed out silk, beef, and wine to ritual scholars and students by rank.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month he visited the Biyong academy, performed the village drinking rite, and bestowed silks, oxen, and wine on the grand master of ceremonies’ erudits and students, each according to scale.

units.zh: 立皇子柬爲汝南王。
units.en: Prince Jian was named king of Runan.
units.literal: He established the imperial son Jian as king of Runan.

units.zh: 十二月，吳夏口督、前將軍孫秀帥眾來奔，拜驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司，封會稽公。
units.en: In the twelfth month: Sun Xiu, Wu’s Xiakou commander, defected with his army and received a ducal title and swift-cavalry command.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Sun Xiu, Wu’s commander at Xiakou and former forward general, led his troops to defect; he was appointed general of swift cavalry with independent command equal to the three excellencies and enfeoffed as duke of Kuaiji.

units.zh: 戊辰，復置鎮軍官。
units.en: On wuchen the “guard the army” office was revived.
units.literal: On the day wuchen the post of general who guards the army was restored.

units.zh: 七年春正月丙午，皇太子冠，賜王公以下帛各有差。
units.en: Seventh year, bingwu: the heir was capped and nobles down the line got graded silk gifts.
units.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the day bingwu, the crown prince underwent the capping ceremony; silks were bestowed on the kings and dukes downward, each according to scale.

units.zh: 匈奴帥劉猛叛出塞。
units.en: The chieftain Liu Meng broke with the court and fled beyond the frontier.
units.literal: The Xiongnu leader Liu Meng rebelled and went out beyond the pass.

units.zh: 三月，孫皓帥眾趨壽陽，遣大司馬望屯淮北以距之。
units.en: Third month: Sun Hao marched on Shouyang; grand marshal Sima Wang took station north of the Huai to meet him.
units.literal: In the third month Sun Hao led his host toward Shouyang; the grand marshal Wang was sent to encamp north of the Huai to block him.

units.zh: 丙戌，司空、鉅鹿公裴秀薨。
units.en: On bingxu [13] Pei Xiu, minister of works, died.
units.literal: On the day bingxu [13] Pei Xiu, minister of works and duke of Julu, died.

units.zh: 癸巳，以中護軍王業爲尚書左僕射，高陽王珪爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Guisi: Wang Ye, Central Protector of the Army, was made left vice-director of the Secretariat, and Sima Gui, King of Gaoyang, was made right vice-director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the day guisi Wang Ye, central protector, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left, and king Gui of Gaoyang senior vice-director of the masters of the right.

units.zh: 孫秀部將何崇帥眾五千人來降。
units.en: Sun Xiu’s officer He Chong brought five thousand soldiers over to Jin.
units.literal: He Chong, a subordinate general under Sun Xiu, led five thousand men to surrender.

units.zh: 夏四月，九真太守董元爲吳將虞氾所攻，軍敗，死之。
units.en: Summer: Wu’s Yu Fan crushed Jiuzhen prefect Dong Yuan in the field.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Dong Yuan, prefect of Jiuzhen, was attacked by Wu general Yu Fan; his army was defeated and he died.

units.zh: 北地胡寇金城，涼州刺史牽弘討之。
units.en: Di raiders struck Jincheng; Liang inspector Qian Hong marched to answer.
units.literal: Northern tribesmen raided Jincheng; Qian Hong, inspector of Liang province, campaigned against them.

units.zh: 群虜內叛，圍弘於青山，弘軍敗，死之。
units.en: The tribesmen turned, trapped Qian Hong on Mount Qing, and killed him.
units.literal: The host of tribes mutinied within, surrounded Qian Hong at Qingshan; his army was defeated and he died.

units.zh: 五月，立皇子憲爲城陽王。
units.en: Prince Xian became king of Chengyang.
units.literal: In the fifth month he established the imperial son Xian as king of Chengyang.

units.zh: 雍、涼、秦三州饑，赦其境內殊死以下。
units.en: Famine in Yong, Liang, and Qin brought an amnesty for all but capital crimes there.
units.literal: Yong, Liang, and Qin provinces suffered famine; he pardoned crimes up to death-without-mercy within their borders.

units.zh: 閏月，大雩，太官減膳。
units.en: Intercalary month: a state prayer for rain went with simpler palace fare.
units.literal: In the intercalary month he held the great rain prayer; the palace kitchen reduced meals.

units.zh: 詔交趾三郡、南中諸郡，無出今年戶調。
units.en: Jiaozhi and the deep south were excused from the year’s head tax.
units.literal: He ordered the three commanderies of Jiaozhi and the southern commanderies to pay no household levy this year.

units.zh: 六月，詔公卿以下舉將帥各一人。
units.en: In the sixth month: every minister had to name a general.
units.literal: In the sixth month he ordered dukes and ministers downward each to recommend one commander.

units.zh: 辛丑，大司馬義陽王望薨。
units.en: On xinchou Sima Wang, grand marshal of Yiyang, died.
units.literal: On the day xinchou grand marshal Sima Wang of Yiyang died.

units.zh: 大雨霖，伊、洛、河溢，流居人四千餘家，殺三百餘人，有詔振貸給棺。
units.en: Long rains fell. The Yi, Luo, and River overflowed, sweeping away more than four thousand households and killing more than three hundred people; an edict ordered relief loans and coffins supplied.
units.literal: Great rains continued; the Yi, Luo, and Yellow River overflowed, sweeping away more than four thousand households and killing more than three hundred persons; an edict ordered relief loans and coffins supplied.

units.zh: 秋七月癸酉，以車騎將軍賈充爲都督秦、涼二州諸軍事。
units.en: Seventh month, guiyou: Jia Chong took joint command of Qin and Liang.
