units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guiyou, Jia Chong, general of chariots and cavalry, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Qin and Liang provinces.

units.zh: 吳將陶璜等圍交趾，太守楊稷與鬱林太守毛炅及日南等三郡降於吳。
units.en: Tao Huang’s Wu army penned Jiaozhi until Yang Ji, Mao Jiong, and the coast surrendered.
units.literal: Wu generals including Tao Huang besieged Jiaozhi; prefect Yang Ji together with Mao Jiong of Yulin and the three commanderies of Rinan and others surrendered to Wu.

units.zh: 八月丙戌，以征東大將軍衛瓘爲征北大將軍、都督幽州諸軍事。
units.en: In the eighth month, on bingxu, Wei Guan was moved from General-in-chief Who Campaigns East to General-in-chief Who Campaigns North and given command of Youzhou military affairs.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on bingxu, Wei Guan, General-in-chief Who Campaigns East, was made General-in-chief Who Campaigns North and Area Commander of military affairs in Youzhou.

units.zh: 丙申，城陽王憲薨。
units.en: On bingshen, Prince Xian of Chengyang died.
units.literal: On bingshen, Xian, Prince of Chengyang, died.

units.zh: 分益州之南中四郡置寧州，曲赦四郡殊死已下。
units.en: The four Nanzhong commanderies were detached from Yizhou to form Ningzhou, and a special amnesty there covered capital offenders and below.
units.literal: The four Nanzhong commanderies of Yizhou were separated to establish Ningzhou, and within the four commanderies those sentenced to death and below were specially pardoned.

units.zh: 冬十月丁丑，日有蝕之。
units.en: Winter, tenth month, dingchou: a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingchou, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 十一月丁巳，衛公姬署薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the dingsi day, Ji Shu, duke of Wei, died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the dingsi day, Ji Shu, duke of Wei, died.

units.zh: 十二月，大雪。
units.en: The twelfth month brought blizzards.
units.literal: In the twelfth month there was heavy snow.

units.zh: 罷中領軍，并北軍中候。
units.en: The inner-army commandant post was folded into the northern-army inspectorate.
units.literal: The central army commandant was abolished and merged into the inspector of the northern armies.

units.zh: 以光祿大夫鄭袤爲司空。
units.en: Zheng Mao became minister of works.
units.literal: Zheng Mao, grand officer of brilliant prosperity, was appointed minister of works.

units.zh: 八年春正月，監軍何楨討匈奴劉猛，累破之，左部帥李恪殺猛而降。
units.en: Eighth year, spring, first month: He Zhen campaigned against the Xiongnu Liu Meng until Li Ke, leader of the left wing, killed Meng and surrendered.
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, army supervisor He Zhen campaigned against the Xiongnu Liu Meng, repeatedly defeated him, and Li Ke, leader of the left wing, killed Meng and surrendered.

units.zh: 癸亥，帝耕于藉田。
units.en: On guihai he turned the soil of the ritual field.
units.literal: On the day guihai the emperor ploughed the sacred field.

units.zh: 二月乙亥，禁彫文綺組非法之物。
units.en: Second month, yihai: luxury embroidery and illegal weave patterns were banned.
units.literal: On the day yihai of the second month carved patterns and illegal brocade weaves were forbidden.

units.zh: 壬辰，太宰、安平王孚薨。
units.en: On renchen Sima Fu, grand preceptor and king of Anping, died.
units.literal: On the day renchen grand preceptor Sima Fu, king of Anping, died.

units.zh: 詔內外群官舉任邊郡者各三人。
units.en: Every office had to name three candidates willing to serve on the border.
units.literal: He ordered civil and military officials within and without each to recommend three men fit to serve on frontier commanderies.

units.zh: 帝與右將軍皇甫陶論事，陶與帝爭言，散騎常侍鄭徽表請罪之。
units.en: Huangfu Tao argued loudly with the throne; Zheng Hui asked that Tao be prosecuted.
units.literal: The emperor discussed affairs with general of the right Huangfu Tao; Tao disputed with the emperor in speech, and Zheng Hui, regular attendant of cavalier, memorialized requesting to punish Tao.

units.zh: 帝曰：「讜言謇諤，所望於左右也。
units.en: The emperor replied, “I want blunt counsel from my attendants.
units.literal: The emperor said: “Straightforward counsel in blunt words is what I expect from those at my side.

units.zh: 人主常以阿媚爲患，豈以爭臣爲損哉！
units.en: Flattery ruins a throne; honest quarrel does not.
units.literal: A ruler always takes flattery as the peril; how could contending ministers be a loss!

units.zh: 徽越職妄奏，豈朕之意。」
units.en: Zheng Hui had no business filing that petition.”
units.literal: Hui overstepped his duty with a reckless memorial—how can that be my intent!”

units.zh: 遂免徽官。
units.en: Zheng Hui was dismissed.
units.literal: Thereupon Hui’s office was removed.

units.zh: 夏四月，置後將軍，以備四軍。
units.en: Summer: a rear general was added to balance the four-army set.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, a rear general was established to complete the four armies.

units.zh: 六月，益州牙門張弘誣其刺史皇甫晏反，殺之，傳首京師。
units.en: In the sixth month: Yi’s gate captain Zhang Hong murdered inspector Huangfu Yan on a false charge of treason.
units.literal: In the sixth month Zhang Hong, camp gate officer of Yi province, falsely accused his inspector Huangfu Yan of rebellion, killed him, and sent the head to the capital.

units.zh: 弘坐伏誅，夷三族。
units.en: Zhang Hong was executed and his kin to the third degree wiped out.
units.literal: Hong was judged guilty and executed, and his three kinships were exterminated.

units.zh: 壬辰，大赦。
units.en: On renchen came a general amnesty.
units.literal: On the day renchen a great amnesty was declared.

units.zh: 丙申，詔復隴右四郡遇寇害者田租。
units.en: On bingshen the four raided Longyou counties were forgiven their grain rent.
units.literal: On the day bingshen an edict remitted field rent for the four Longyou commanderies that had suffered bandit harm.

units.zh: 秋七月，以車騎將軍賈充爲司空。
units.en: Seventh month: Jia Chong traded his army command for the ministry of works.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Jia Chong, general of chariots and cavalry, was appointed minister of works.

units.zh: 九月，吳西陵督步闡來降，拜衛將軍、開府儀同三司，封宜都公。
units.en: In the ninth month: Bu Chan defected from Wu’s Xiling garrison and received guard-general rank and the title duke of Yidu.
units.literal: In the ninth month Bu Chan, Wu’s commander at Xiling, came to surrender; he was appointed guard general with independent command equal to the three excellencies and enfeoffed as duke of Yidu.

units.zh: 吳將陸抗攻闡，遣車騎將軍羊祜帥眾出江陵，荊州刺史楊肇迎闡於西陵，巴東監軍徐胤擊建平以救闡。
units.en: Lu Kang besieged Bu Chan while Yang Hu marched from Jiangling, Yang Zhao raced to Xiling, and Xu Yin hit Jianping to break the ring.
units.literal: Wu general Lu Kang attacked Chan; chariots-and-cavalry general Yang Hu led a host out from Jiangling; Yang Zhao, inspector of Jing, went to welcome Chan at Xiling; Xu Yin, army supervisor of Badong, struck Jianping to relieve Chan.

units.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Winter, new moon on xinwei: eclipse of the sun.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day xinwei, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 十二月，肇攻抗，不克而還。
units.en: In the twelfth month: Yang Zhao failed against Lu Kang and pulled back.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Yang Zhao attacked Lu Kang, did not overcome him, and withdrew.

units.zh: 闡城陷，爲抗所禽。
units.en: Xiling fell and Bu Chan fell into Lu Kang’s hands.
units.literal: Chan’s city fell and he was captured by Kang.

units.zh: 九年春正月辛酉，司空、密陵侯鄭袤薨。
units.en: Ninth year, spring, first month, xinyou: Zheng Mao, minister of works and marquis of Miling, died.
units.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on the day xinyou, Zheng Mao, minister of works and marquis of Miling, died.

units.zh: 二月癸巳，司徒、樂陵公石苞薨。
units.en: Second month, guisi: Shi Bao, steward of the masters of the people and duke of Leling, died.
units.literal: On the day guisi of the second month Shi Bao, steward of the masters of the people and duke of Leling, died.

units.zh: 立安平亭侯隆爲安平王。
units.en: Marquis Long of Anping village was promoted to king of Anping.
units.literal: He established Long, marquis of the village of Anping, as king of Anping.

units.zh: 三月，立皇子祗爲東海王。
units.en: Prince Zhi became king of Donghai.
units.literal: In the third month he established the imperial son Zhi as king of Donghai.

units.zh: 夏四月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Summer opened on wuchen with another eclipse.
units.literal: On the first day of summer, fourth month, wuchen, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 五月，旱。
units.en: The fifth month was rainless.
units.literal: In the fifth month there was drought.

units.zh: 以太保何曾領司徒。
units.en: He Zeng added the stewardship of the masters of the people to his grand protector’s hat.
units.literal: Grand protector He Zeng was additionally appointed steward of the masters of the people.

units.zh: 六月乙未，東海王祗薨。
units.en: Sixth month, yiwei: the king of Donghai, Zhi, died.
units.literal: On the day yiwei of the sixth month king Zhi of Donghai died.

units.zh: 秋七月丁酉朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Autumn began on dingyou with yet another eclipse.
units.literal: On the first day of autumn, seventh month, dingyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 吳將魯淑圍弋陽，征虜將軍王渾擊敗之。
units.en: Lu Shu of Wu surrounded Yiyang until Wang Hun broke the siege.
units.literal: Wu general Lu Shu besieged Yiyang; Wang Hun, general who subdues captives, defeated him.

units.zh: 罷五官左右中郎將、弘訓太僕、衛尉、大長秋等官。
units.en: A bundle of sinecures—five-department generals, Hongxun coachman, commandant of guards, grand prolonger of autumn—was cut.
units.literal: The posts of senior and junior generals of the gentlemen of the five departments, grand coachman of Hongxun, commandant of the guards, and grand prolonger of autumn were abolished.

units.zh: 鮮卑寇廣寧，殺略五千人。
units.en: Xianbei horsemen sacked Guangning and took five thousand lives or captives.
units.literal: The Xianbei raided Guangning, killing and carrying off about five thousand people.

units.zh: 詔聘公卿以下子女以備六宮，采擇未畢，權禁斷婚姻。
units.en: The court began drafting noble youths for the harem and froze all weddings until the levy ended.
units.literal: An edict ordered recruitment of sons and daughters of dukes and ministers downward to fill the six palaces; until the selection was finished, marriages were temporarily forbidden.

units.zh: 冬十月辛巳，制女年十七父母不嫁者，使長吏配之。
units.en: Winter, xinsi: any unmarried girl of seventeen would be paired off by the magistrate.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinsi, it was decreed that if a girl of seventeen had not been married by her parents, the chief should assign her a husband.

units.zh: 十一月丁酉，臨宣武觀大閱諸軍，甲辰乃罷。
units.en: Eleventh month, dingyou: he watched a full army parade at Xuanwu Gate until jiachen.
units.literal: On the day dingyou of the eleventh month he attended the Xuanwu review stand to inspect the armies in grand review; on jiachen it ended.

units.zh: 十年春正月辛亥，帝耕于藉田。
units.en: Tenth year, spring, xinhai: another ploughing rite.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the day xinhai, the emperor ploughed the sacred field.

units.zh: 閏月癸酉，太傅、壽光公鄭沖薨。
units.en: Intercalary guiyou: grand tutor Zheng Chong died.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day guiyou, Zheng Chong, grand tutor and duke of Shouguang, died.

units.zh: 己卯，高陽王珪薨。
units.en: On jimao Sima Gui of Gaoyang died.
units.literal: On the day jimao king Gui of Gaoyang died.

units.zh: 庚辰，太原王瑰薨。
units.en: On gengchen Sima Gui of Taiyuan died.
units.literal: On the day gengchen king Gui of Taiyuan died.

units.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「嫡庶之別，所以辨上下，明貴賤。
units.en: On dinghai, an edict said, "The distinction between principal and secondary lines is how upper and lower are distinguished and noble and base are made clear.
units.literal: On the day dinghai an edict said: “The distinction between legitimate wife and concubine’s sons is how one distinguishes high from low and clarifies noble from base.

units.zh: 而近世以來，多皆內寵，登妃后之職，亂尊卑之序。
units.en: In recent reigns, however, palace favorites had climbed to empress and thrown the proper order of rank into confusion.
units.literal: Yet in recent generations many have been inner favorites who ascended to the posts of consort and empress, disordering the sequence of honored and humble.

units.zh: 自今以後，皆不得登用妾媵以爲嫡正。」
units.en: Henceforth no concubine may be elevated to the rank of principal consort."
units.literal: From this time onward none may promote a concubine or handmaid to be legitimate principal wife."

units.zh: 二月，分幽州五郡置平州。
units.en: The second month saw Ping province carved from five Youzhou counties.
units.literal: In the second month five commanderies of Youzhou were split off to establish Ping province.

units.zh: 三月癸亥，日有蝕之。
units.en: Third month, guihai: a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On the day guihai of the third month there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 夏四月己未，太尉、臨淮公荀顗薨。
units.en: In summer, the fourth month, on jiwei: Xun Yi, grand commandant and duke of Linhuai, died.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiwei, Xun Yi, grand commandant and duke of Linhuai, died.

units.zh: 六月癸巳，臨聽訟觀錄囚徒，多所原遣。
units.en: Sixth month, guisi: another prison review freed many inmates.
units.literal: On the day guisi of the sixth month he attended the hall for hearing lawsuits, reviewed prisoners, and many were pardoned or released.

units.zh: 是夏，大蝗。
units.en: Locusts swarmed that summer.
units.literal: That summer there were great locusts.

units.zh: 秋七月丙寅，皇后楊氏崩。
units.en: Seventh month, bingyin: Empress Yang passed away.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingyin, Empress Yang died.

units.zh: 壬午，吳平虜將孟泰、偏將軍王嗣等帥眾降。
units.en: Renwu: Wu officers Meng Tai and Wang Si brought their men over to Jin.
units.literal: On the day renwu Wu’s general who pacifies captives Meng Tai, deputy general Wang Si, and others led their troops to surrender.

units.zh: 八月，涼州虜寇金城諸郡，鎮西將軍、汝陰王駿討之，斬其帥乞文泥等。
units.en: Eighth month: Liang tribes raided Jincheng until Sima Jun, king of Ru'yin, cut down chiefs such as Qi Wenni.
units.literal: In the eighth month tribesmen of Liang province raided the commanderies around Jincheng; Sima Jun, great general who guards the west and king of Ru'yin, campaigned against them and beheaded their leaders Qi Wenni and others.

units.zh: 戊申，葬元皇后于峻陽陵。
units.en: On wushen Empress Yuan was laid to rest at Junyang.
units.literal: On the day wushen Empress Yuan was buried at Junyang mausoleum.

units.zh: 九月癸亥，以大將軍陳騫爲太尉。
units.en: Ninth month, guihai: Chen Qian became grand commandant.
units.literal: On the day guihai of the ninth month great general Chen Qian was appointed grand commandant.

units.zh: 攻拔吳枳里城，獲吳立信校尉莊祐。
units.en: Jin troops seized Zhili and took colonel Zhuang You prisoner.
units.literal: They stormed and took Wu’s fortress town Zhili and captured Wu’s established-trustworthiness colonel Zhuang You.

units.zh: 吳將孫遵、李承帥眾寇江夏，太守嵇喜擊破之。
units.en: Sun Zun and Li Cheng struck Jiangxia but Ji Xi drove them off.
units.literal: Wu generals Sun Zun and Li Cheng led a host to raid Jiangxia; prefect Ji Xi defeated them.

units.zh: 立河橋于富平津。
units.en: A bridge over the River was built at Fuping ford.
units.literal: They built a river bridge at Fuping ford.

units.zh: 冬十一月，立城東七里澗石橋。
units.en: Winter: a stone span was built east of Luoyang over the Seven-li Ditch.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month they erected a stone bridge over the seven-li gully east of the city.

units.zh: 庚午，帝臨宣武觀，大閱諸軍。
units.en: On gengwu he reviewed the hosts at Xuanwu Gate.
units.literal: On the day gengwu the emperor attended the Xuanwu review stand and held a grand review of the armies.

units.zh: 十二月，有星孛于軫。
units.en: In the twelfth month: a comet trailed through Zhen.
units.literal: In the twelfth month a broom star appeared in the asterism Zhen.

units.zh: 置藉田令。
units.en: A superintendent of the ritual plough-lands was added to the roster.
units.literal: They established the office of director of the sacred field.

units.zh: 立太原王子緝爲高陽王。
units.en: The Taiyuan king’s son Ji was promoted to king of Gaoyang.
units.literal: He established Ji, son of the king of Taiyuan, as king of Gaoyang.

units.zh: 吳威北將軍嚴聰、揚威將軍嚴整、偏將軍朱買來降。
units.en: Wu’s northern commanders Yan Cong, Yan Zheng, and Zhu Mai defected with their units.
units.literal: Wu’s general who awes the north Yan Cong, general who raises might Yan Zheng, and deputy general Zhu Mai came to surrender.

units.zh: 是歲，鑿陝南山，決河，東注洛，以通運漕。
units.en: Engineers cut a channel through the southern Shan range to swing the river east into the Luo and ease grain barges.
units.literal: That year they cut through the southern Shaan range, breached the river, and sent it eastward into the Luo to open transport by water.

units.zh: 咸寧元年春正月戊午朔，大赦，改元。
units.en: Xianning opened on wuwu with amnesty and a new era name.
units.literal: In the first year of Xianning, spring, first month, on the first day wuwu, there was a great amnesty and the reign title was changed.

units.zh: 二月，以將士應已娶者多，家有五女者給復。
units.en: The second month brought relief for families swamped with daughters: any household raising five girls was excused from labor levies, so married soldiers could still serve without ruining their kin.
units.literal: In the second month, because many officers and soldiers due for enrollment were already married, households that had five daughters were granted exemption from corvée.

units.zh: 辛酉，以故鄴令夏謖有清稱，賜穀百斛。
units.en: Xinyou [14]: Xia Mo, once magistrate of Ye, received a hundred hu for his clean name.
units.literal: On the day xinyou [14], because former Ye magistrate Xia Mo enjoyed a reputation for purity, he was granted one hundred hu of grain.

units.zh: 以奉祿薄，賜公卿以下帛有差。
units.en: Slender salaries were padded with graded silk gifts to the bureaucracy.
units.literal: Because stipends were thin, silks were bestowed on the dukes and ministers downward, each according to difference.

units.zh: 叛虜樹機能送質請降。
units.en: The Di rebel Shujineng offered hostages and sued for peace.
units.literal: The mutinous tribesman Shujineng sent hostages and asked to surrender.

units.zh: 夏五月，下邳、廣陵大風，拔木，壞廬舍。
units.en: Summer, fifth month: great winds in Xiapi and Guangling uprooted trees and damaged huts and houses.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, great winds at Xiapi and Guangling uprooted trees and ruined huts.

units.zh: 六月，鮮卑力微遣子來獻。
units.en: Sixth month: Xianbei chief Liwei’s son arrived with gifts.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Xianbei chief Liwei sent his son to present tribute.

units.zh: 吳人寇江夏。
units.en: Wu raiders hit Jiangxia again.
units.literal: Wu men raided Jiangxia.

units.zh: 西域戊己校尉馬循討叛鮮卑，破之，斬其渠帥。
units.en: Western Regions colonel Ma Xun crushed rebel Xianbei and took their chief’s head.
units.literal: Ma Xun, Wu-ji colonel of the Western Regions, campaigned against mutinous Xianbei, defeated them, and beheaded their chieftain.

units.zh: 戊申，置太子詹事官。
units.en: On wushen the crown prince gained a full household administration.
units.literal: On the day wushen the office of superintendent of the heir apparent’s household was established.

units.zh: 秋七月甲申晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: Month’s end, jiashen: eclipse of the sun.
units.literal: On the last day of the seventh month, jiashen, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 郡國螟。
units.en: Crop-worms blighted fields across the provinces.
units.literal: The commanderies and principalities suffered from grain-eating caterpillars.

units.zh: 八月壬寅，沛王子文薨。
units.en: In the eighth month, on renyin, Ziwen, Prince of Pei, died.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on renyin, Ziwen, Prince of Pei, died.

units.zh: 以故太傅鄭沖、太尉荀顗、司徒石苞、司空裴秀、驃騎將軍王沈、安平獻王孚等及太保何曾、司空賈充、太尉陳騫、中書監荀勖、平南將軍羊祜、齊王攸等皆列於銘饗。
units.en: Zheng Chong, Xun Yi, Shi Bao, Pei Xiu, Wang Chen, Prince Fu of Anping, He Zeng, Jia Chong, Chen Qian, Xun Xu, Yang Hu, Prince You of Qi, and others were all entered among those honored in commemorative offerings.
units.literal: The late Grand Tutor Zheng Chong, Grand Commandant Xun Yi, Minister over the Masses Shi Bao, Minister of Works Pei Xiu, General of Agile Cavalry Wang Chen, Prince Xian Fu of Anping, and others, together with Grand Protector He Zeng, Minister of Works Jia Chong, Grand Commandant Chen Qian, Palace Secretariat Director Xun Xu, General Who Pacifies the South Yang Hu, Prince You of Qi, and others, were all listed for inscribed offerings.

units.zh: 九月甲子，青州螟，徐州大水。
units.en: Ninth month, jiazi: Qing province suffered grain insects, and Xu province suffered great floods.
units.literal: On the day jiazi of the ninth month Qing province had caterpillars and Xu province great floods.

units.zh: 冬十月乙酉，常山王殷薨。
units.en: Tenth month, yiyou: Sima Yin of Changshan died.
units.literal: On the day yiyou of the tenth month king Yin of Changshan died.

units.zh: 癸巳，彭城王權薨。
units.en: Guisi: the Pengcheng king Sima Quan died.
units.literal: On the day guisi king Quan of Pengcheng died.

units.zh: 十一月癸亥，大閱於宣武觀，至于己巳。
units.en: Guihai to jisi: another full-dress parade at Xuanwu.
units.literal: On the day guihai of the eleventh month a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand until jisi.

units.zh: 十二月丁亥，追尊宣帝廟曰高祖，景帝曰世宗，文帝曰太祖。
units.en: Dinghai: Xuan, Jing, and Wen received temple names Gaozu, Shizong, and Taizu.
units.literal: On the day dinghai of the twelfth month posthumous temple names were raised: emperor Xuan as Gaozu, emperor Jing as Shizong, emperor Wen as Taizu.

units.zh: 是月大疫，洛陽死者太半。
units.en: A plague carried off over half of Luoyang that month.
units.literal: That month a great pestilence struck; more than half died in Luoyang.

units.zh: 封裴頠爲鉅鹿公。
units.en: Pei Wei received the Julu ducal title.
units.literal: Pei Wei was enfeoffed as duke of Julu.

units.zh: 二年春正月，以疾疫廢朝。
units.en: Xianning 2 opened with plague so severe that regular court was canceled.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, court was suspended because of pestilence.

units.zh: 賜諸散吏至于士卒絲各有差。
units.en: Even petty clerks and rank-and-file troops received graded silk handouts.
units.literal: Silks were bestowed on all clerks in miscellaneous service down to common soldiers, each according to difference.

units.zh: 二月丙戌，河間王洪薨。
units.en: Second month, bingxu: Sima Hong of Hejian died.
units.literal: On the day bingxu of the second month king Hong of Hejian died.

units.zh: 甲午，赦五歲刑以下。
units.en: Jiawu: sentences of five years or less were remitted.
units.literal: On the day jiawu he pardoned penal labor up to five years.

units.zh: 東夷八國歸化。
units.en: Eight Yi polities along the eastern seaboard asked to enter the map as Jin subjects.
units.literal: Eight states of the eastern Yi came to submit and accept imperial rule.

units.zh: 并州虜犯塞，監并州諸軍事胡奮擊破之。
units.en: Bing tribes raided the wall; Hu Fen, Bing’s military supervisor, beat them back.
units.literal: Tribesmen of Bing province violated the frontier; Hu Fen, supervisor of all military affairs of Bing, defeated them.

units.zh: 初，燉煌太守尹璩卒，州以燉煌令梁澄領太守事，議郎令狐豐廢澄，自領郡事。
units.en: Earlier, Dunhuang had fallen into chaos after Yin Qu’s death: Linghu Feng ousted Liang Cheng, the magistrate who was acting as prefect, and seized the prefecture.
units.literal: At first, when Dunhuang prefect Yin Qu died, the province had ordered Dunhuang magistrate Liang Cheng to act as prefect; gentleman in discussion Linghu Feng removed Cheng and himself took charge of the commandery.

units.zh: 豐死，弟宏代之。
units.en: When Linghu Feng died, his brother Hong continued the usurpation.
units.literal: When Feng died, his younger brother Hong replaced him.

units.zh: 至是，涼州刺史楊欣斬宏，傳首洛陽。
units.en: Now Yang Xin, Liang’s inspector, beheaded Hong and shipped the head to the capital.
units.literal: At this point Yang Xin, inspector of Liang province, executed Hong and sent the head to Luoyang.

units.zh: 先是，帝不豫，及瘳，群臣上壽。
units.en: After his illness lifted, the court wanted to celebrate his recovery with formal toasts.
units.literal: Before this the emperor had been indisposed; when he recovered, the host of ministers offered congratulations on his longevity.

units.zh: 詔曰：「每念頃遇疫氣死亡，爲之愴然。
units.en: He refused: “Each time I remember the plague’s toll, grief stops my breath.
units.literal: An edict said: “Whenever I think how lately the pestilence carried off so many dead, my heart is stricken.

units.zh: 豈以一身之休息，忘百姓之艱邪？
units.en: How could I indulge my own comfort while the people still mourn?
units.literal: How could I, for the ease of one body, forget the hardship of the hundred surnames?

units.zh: 諸上禮者皆絕之。」
units.en: Cancel every proposal for congratulatory banquets.”
units.literal: All who would present congratulatory rites are to desist.”

units.zh: 夏五月，鎮西大將軍、汝陰王駿討北胡，斬其渠帥吐敦。
units.en: Summer: Sima Jun struck northern tribes and killed their chief Tudun.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Sima Jun, great general who guards the west and king of Ru'yin, campaigned against the northern Hu and beheaded their chieftain Tudun.

units.zh: 立國子學。
units.en: The imperial university opened its doors.
units.literal: The national university was established.

units.zh: 庚午，大雩。
units.en: On gengwu the court prayed for rain.
units.literal: On the day gengwu he held the great rain prayer.

units.zh: 六月癸丑，薦荔支于太廟。
units.en: Sixth month, guichou: fresh lychees went onto the ancestral altar.
units.literal: On the day guichou of the sixth month lychees were offered in the grand temple.

units.zh: 甲戌，有星孛于氐。
units.en: Jiaxu [15]: a comet shone in the asterism Di.
units.literal: On the day jiaxu [15] a broom star appeared in the asterism Di.

units.zh: 自春旱，至于是月始雨。
units.en: The long spring drought broke at last in the sixth month.
units.literal: From spring there had been drought; only in this month did rain begin.

units.zh: 吳京下督孫楷帥眾來降，以爲車騎將軍，封丹楊侯。
units.en: Sun Kai, Wu’s capital-area commander, defected and became chariots-and-cavalry general, marquis of Danyang.
units.literal: Sun Kai, Wu’s commander below the capital, led his host to surrender; he was appointed general of chariots and cavalry and enfeoffed as marquis of Danyang.

units.zh: 白龍二見于新興井中。
units.en: Two white dragons were reported in a Xinxing village well.
units.literal: Two white dragons were seen in a well at Xinxing.

units.zh: 秋七月，有星孛于大角。
units.en: Seventh month: a comet hung at the bright star Arcturus.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, a broom star appeared at Dajiao.

units.zh: 吳臨平湖自漢末壅塞，至是自開。
units.en: Linping Lake in Wu, silted since Han’s end, suddenly cleared.
units.literal: Wu’s Linping Lake, blocked since late Han, opened of itself at this time.

units.zh: 父老相傳云：「此湖塞，天下亂；
units.en: Local graybeards said, “When Linping dams up, the empire totters.
units.literal: The elders handed down a saying: “When this lake is blocked, the realm is in chaos.

units.zh: 此湖開，天下平」癸丑，安平王隆薨。
units.en: When it opens again, peace returns.” On guichou Sima Long of Anping died.
units.literal: When this lake opens, the realm is at peace.” On the day guichou king Long of Anping died.

units.zh: 東夷十七國內附。
units.en: Seventeen Yi realms asked for annexation.
units.literal: Seventeen states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.

units.zh: 河南、魏郡暴水，殺百餘人，詔給棺。
units.en: Cloudbursts in Henan and Wei drowned over a hundred; the court paid for coffins.
units.literal: Henan and Wei commandery suffered violent floods that killed more than a hundred persons; an edict ordered coffins supplied.

units.zh: 鮮卑阿羅多等寇邊，西域戊己校尉馬循討之，斬首四千餘級，獲生九千餘人，於是來降。
units.en: Xianbei chief Arluoduo raided the line until Ma Xun killed four thousand and took nine thousand prisoners, after which they yielded.
units.literal: The Xianbei Arluoduo and others raided the frontier; Ma Xun, Wu-ji colonel of the Western Regions, campaigned against them, beheading more than four thousand grades and capturing more than nine thousand alive; thereupon they came to surrender.

units.zh: 八月庚辰，河東、平陽地震。
units.en: Eighth month, gengchen: Hedong and Pingyang shook.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengchen, Hedong and Pingyang suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 己亥，以太保何曾爲太傅，太尉陳騫爲大司馬，司空賈充爲太尉，鎮軍大將軍齊王攸爲司空。
units.en: Jihai reshuffled the summit: He Zeng to grand tutor, Chen Qian to grand marshal, Jia Chong to grand commandant, Sima You to minister of works.
units.literal: On the day jihai He Zeng, grand protector, was made grand tutor; Chen Qian, grand commandant, grand marshal; Jia Chong, minister of works, grand commandant; Sima You, great general who guards the army and king of Qi, minister of works.

units.zh: 有星孛于太微，九月又孛于翼。
units.en: A comet crossed the “Supreme Palace” asterism in the eighth month; a second brushed the Wings mansion in the ninth.
units.literal: In the eighth month a broom star appeared in Supreme Palace Enclosure; in the ninth month another appeared in Yi.

units.zh: 丁未，起太倉於城東，常平倉於東西市。
units.en: Dingwei: a state granary rose east of Luoyang, with “ever-normal” bins in both market wards.
units.literal: On the day dingwei they raised a grand granary east of the city and ever-normal granaries in the eastern and western markets.

units.en: The recension marks commentary note sixteen here.
units.literal: Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 閏月，荊州五郡水，流四千餘家。
units.en: Intercalary month: Jing floods displaced over four thousand families.
units.literal: In the intercalary month five commanderies of Jing province flooded, sweeping away more than four thousand households.

units.zh: 冬十月，以汝陰王駿爲征西大將軍，平南將軍羊祜爲征南大將軍。
units.en: Winter: Sima Jun became western expedition commander, Yang Hu southern expedition commander.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Sima Jun, king of Ru'yin, was made great general who campaigns west, and Yang Hu, general who pacifies the south, great general who campaigns south.

units.zh: 丁卯，立皇后楊氏，大赦，賜王公以下及于鰥寡各有差。
units.en: Dingmao: a new empress Yang, general amnesty, and graded gifts from princes down to the destitute.
units.literal: On the day dingmao he established lady Yang as empress, declared a great amnesty, and bestowed gifts on the kings and dukes downward to widowers and widows, each according to difference.

units.zh: 十一月，白龍二見于梁國。
units.en: In the eleventh month: twin white dragons in Liang.
units.literal: In the eleventh month two white dragons were seen in the principality of Liang.

units.zh: 十二月，徵處士安定皇甫謐爲太子中庶子，封后父鎮軍將軍楊駿爲臨晉侯。
units.en: In the twelfth month he called scholar Huangfu Mi to tutor the heir and made empress Yang’s father Yang Jun marquis of Linjin.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the recluse Huangfu Mi of Anding was summoned as palace attendant to the heir apparent, and the empress’s father, Yang Jun, general who guards the army, was enfeoffed as marquis of Linjin.

units.zh: 是月，以平州刺史傅詢、前廣平太守孟桓清白有聞，詢賜帛二百匹，桓百匹。
units.en: The same month rewarded honest officials—two hundred rolls for Fu Xun, one hundred for Meng Huan.
units.literal: That month, because Pingzhou inspector Fu Xun and former Guangping prefect Meng Huan were reputed incorrupt, Xun was granted two hundred bolts of silk and Huan one hundred.

units.zh: 三年春正月丙子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third year, spring, first month, on the bingzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the bingzi new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 立皇子裕爲始平王，安平穆王隆弟敦爲安平王。
units.en: The emperor made his son Yu prince of Shiping and made Dun, younger brother of Long, Prince Mu of Anping, prince of Anping.
units.literal: The imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Shiping, and Dun, younger brother of Long, Prince Mu of Anping, was established as Prince of Anping.

units.zh: 詔曰：「宗室戚屬，國之枝葉，欲令奉率德義，爲天下式。
units.en: An edict declared: "The imperial kin are the state's branches and leaves; they should uphold virtue and righteousness and serve as models for the realm.
units.literal: An edict said: "The imperial clan and kin by marriage are the branches and leaves of the state; I wish to have them uphold and lead in virtue and righteousness, becoming a model for the realm.

units.zh: 然處富貴而能慎行者寡，召穆公糾合兄弟而賦唐棣之詩，此姬氏所以本枝百世也。
units.en: Yet few men in wealth and rank remain careful. Lord Mu of Shao gathered his brothers and sang Tangdi; by such means the Ji clan preserved root and branch for generations.
units.literal: Yet few who occupy wealth and rank can conduct themselves cautiously; Lord Mu of Shao gathered his brothers and composed the poem Tangdi, and this was how the Ji lineage kept root and branch for a hundred generations.

units.zh: 今以衛將軍、扶風王亮爲宗師，所當施行，皆諮之於宗師也。」
units.en: I now appoint Liang, Prince of Fufeng and Guards General, as Master of the Clan; all clan measures are to be referred to him."
units.literal: Now I make the Guards General, Liang, Prince of Fufeng, Master of the Clan; all measures to be carried out shall be consulted with the Master of the Clan."

units.zh: 庚寅，始平王裕薨。
units.en: On gengyin, Prince Yu of Shiping died.
units.literal: On gengyin, Yu, Prince of Shiping, died.

units.zh: 有星孛於西方。
units.en: A comet appeared in the west.
units.literal: There was a broom star in the west.

units.zh: 使征北大將軍衛瓘討鮮卑力微。
units.en: Wei Guan, General-in-chief Who Campaigns North, was sent against the Xianbei leader Liwei.
units.literal: He sent Wei Guan, General-in-chief Who Campaigns North, to campaign against Liwei of the Xianbei.

units.zh: 三月，平虜護軍文淑討叛虜樹機能等，並破之。
units.en: Third month: Wen Shu, Protector-general Who Pacifies the Captives, defeated the rebel forces of Shujineng and the others.
units.literal: In the third month, Wen Shu, Protector-general Who Pacifies the Captives, campaigned against the rebel captives Shujineng and the others and defeated them all.

units.zh: 有星孛于胃。
units.en: A comet trailed through the Wei mansion.
units.literal: A broom star appeared in the asterism Wei.

units.zh: 乙未，帝將射雉，慮損麥苗而止。
units.en: Yiwei: he canceled a hunt lest arrows trample the wheat.
units.literal: On the day yiwei the emperor was about to shoot pheasants but stopped, fearing damage to the wheat.

units.zh: 夏五月戊子，吳將邵凱、夏祥帥眾七千餘人來降。
units.en: Summer, wuzi: Shao Kai and Xia Xiang brought seven thousand Wu soldiers over.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day wuzi, Wu generals Shao Kai and Xia Xiang led more than seven thousand men to surrender.

units.en: The recension marks commentary note eighteen here.
units.literal: Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 六月，益、梁八郡水，殺三百餘人，沒邸閣別倉。
units.en: In the sixth month: flash floods in Yi and Liang drowned three hundred and swamped auxiliary granaries.
units.literal: In the sixth month eight commanderies of Yi and Liang suffered floods that killed more than three hundred persons and submerged lodge granaries outside the main depots.

units.zh: 秋七月，以都督豫州諸軍事王渾爲都督揚州諸軍事。
units.en: Autumn, seventh month: Wang Hun, commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Yu province, was made commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Yang province.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Wang Hun, supervisor of all military affairs of Yu province, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Yang province.

units.zh: 中山王睦以罪廢爲丹水侯。
units.en: Sima Mu of Zhongshan lost his kingship for misconduct and became marquis of Danshui.
units.literal: King Mu of Zhongshan was stripped of rank for a crime and made marquis of Danshui.

units.zh: 八月癸亥，徙扶風王亮爲汝南王，東莞王伷爲琅邪王，汝陰王駿爲扶風王，琅邪王倫爲趙王，渤海王輔爲太原王，太原王顒爲河間王，北海王陵爲任城王，陳王斌爲西河王，汝南王柬爲南陽王，濟南王耽爲中山王，河間王威爲章武王。
units.en: Guihai: a wholesale rotation of princely fiefs—Liang to Runan, Zhou to Langye, Jun to Fufeng, Lun to Zhao, Fu of Bohai to Taiyuan, Yong of Taiyuan to Hejian, Ling of Beihai to Rencheng, Bin of Chen to Xihe, Jian of Runan to Nanyang, Dan of Jinan to Zhongshan, and Wei of Hejian to Zhangwu.
units.literal: On the day guihai of the eighth month king Liang of Fufeng was transferred to king of Runan, king Zhou of Dongguan to king of Langye, king Jun of Ru'yin to king of Fufeng, king Lun of Langye to king of Zhao, king Fu of Bohai to king of Taiyuan, king Yong of Taiyuan to king of Hejian, king Ling of Beihai to king of Rencheng, king Bin of Chen to king of Xihe, king Jian of Runan to king of Nanyang, king Dan of Jinan to king of Zhongshan, king Wei of Hejian to king of Zhangwu.

units.zh: 立皇子瑋爲始平王，允爲濮陽王，該爲新都王，遐爲清河王，鉅平侯羊祜爲南城侯。
units.en: The imperial sons Wei, Yun, Gai, and Xia were made kings of Shiping, Puyang, Xindu, and Qinghe, while Yang Hu traded Juping for the Nancheng marquisate.
units.literal: He established the imperial son Wei as king of Shiping, Yun as king of Puyang, Gai as king of Xindu, Xia as king of Qinghe, and marquis Yang Hu of Juping as marquis of Nancheng.

units.zh: 以汝南王亮爲鎮南大將軍。
units.en: Sima Liang of Runan took southern command.
units.literal: King Liang of Runan was appointed great general who guards the south.

units.zh: 大風拔樹，暴寒且冰，郡國五隕霜，傷穀。
units.en: Gales, sudden frost, and ice [19] damaged crops in five provinces.
units.literal: Great winds uprooted trees; violent cold brought ice [19]; five commanderies reported killing frost that injured the grain.

units.zh: 九月戊子，以左將軍胡奮爲都督江北諸軍事。
units.en: Ninth month, wuzi: Hu Fen, General of the Left, was made commander-in-chief of all military affairs north of the Yangzi.
units.literal: On the day wuzi of the ninth month Hu Fen, general of the left, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs north of the Yangzi.

units.zh: 兗、豫、徐、青、荊、益、梁七州大水，傷秋稼，詔振給之。
units.en: Seven provinces flooded at once, ruining the autumn crop; grain relief followed.
units.literal: The seven provinces Yan, Yu, Xu, Qing, Jing, Yi, and Liang suffered great floods that injured the autumn harvest; an edict ordered relief.

units.zh: 立齊王子蕤爲遼東王，贊爲廣漢王。
units.en: The Qi king’s sons Rui and Zan became princes of Liaodong and Guanghan.
units.literal: He established Rui and Zan, sons of the king of Qi, as kings of Liaodong and Guanghan respectively.

units.zh: 冬十一月丙戌，帝臨宣武觀大閱，至于壬辰。
units.en: Winter, bingxu to renchen: another army parade at Xuanwu.
units.literal: On the day bingxu of winter, the eleventh month, the emperor attended the Xuanwu stand for a grand review until renchen.

units.zh: 十二月，吳將孫慎入江夏、汝南，略千餘家而去。
units.en: In the twelfth month: Sun Shen raided Jiangxia and Runan, dragging off a thousand families.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Wu general Sun Shen entered Jiangxia and Runan, carried off more than a thousand households, and withdrew.

units.zh: 是歲，西北雜虜及鮮卑、匈奴、五溪蠻夷、東夷三國前後十餘輩，[20]各帥種人部落內附。
units.en: Year’s end saw a wave of defections—steppe tribes, Xianbei, Xiongnu, Wuxi peoples, and three Yi realms [20]—each chief bringing his people in.
units.literal: That year more than ten parties of northwestern miscellaneous tribes, Xianbei, Xiongnu, Wuxi Man-yi, and three eastern Yi states [20], each leading their clans and tribes, submitted within the borders.

units.zh: 四年春正月庚午朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Fourth year, new moon on gengwu: eclipse.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the first day gengwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 三月甲申，尚書左僕射盧欽卒。
units.en: Third month, jiashen: Lu Qin died in office.
units.literal: On the day jiashen of the third month Lu Qin, senior vice-director of the masters of the left, died.

units.zh: 辛酉，以尚書右僕射山濤爲尚書左僕射。
units.en: Xinyou: Shan Tao moved from right to left vice-president of the secretariat.
units.literal: On the day xinyou, Shan Tao, senior vice-director of the masters of the right, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left.

units.zh: 東夷六國來獻。
units.en: Six Yi realms along the coast sent tribute embassies.
units.literal: Six states of the eastern Yi came to present tribute.

units.zh: 夏四月，蚩尤旗見於東井。
units.en: Summer: a long-tailed “Chiyou” comet blazed above the Eastern Well asterism.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the “Chiyou banner” comet appeared in the Eastern Well mansion.

units.zh: 六月丁未，陰平、廣武地震，甲子又震。
units.en: Sixth month, dingwei: Yinping and Guangwu shook; aftershocks hit on jiazi.
units.literal: On the day dingwei of the sixth month there were earthquakes at Yinping and Guangwu; on jiazi there were earthquakes again.

units.zh: 涼州刺史楊欣與虜若羅拔能等戰于武威，敗績，死之。
units.en: Liang inspector Yang Xin died in defeat at Wuwei fighting Ruluobaneng and others.
units.literal: Yang Xin, inspector of Liang province, fought the tribesmen Ruluobaneng and others at Wuwei, was routed, and died.

units.zh: 弘訓皇后羊氏崩。
units.en: Lady Yang, dowager empress of the Hongxun palace, passed away.
units.literal: Empress Yang of the Hongxun palace died.

units.zh: 秋七月己丑，祔葬景獻皇后羊氏于峻平陵。
units.en: Seventh month, jichou: Empress Jingxian was laid beside her husband at Junping tomb.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jichou, Empress Jingxian, lady Yang, was given joint burial at Junping mausoleum.

units.zh: 庚寅，高陽王緝薨。
units.en: Gengyin: Sima Ji of Gaoyang died.
units.literal: On the day gengyin king Ji of Gaoyang died.

units.zh: 癸巳，范陽王綏薨。
units.en: Guisi: Sima Sui of Fanyang died.
units.literal: On the day guisi king Sui of Fanyang died.

units.zh: 荊、揚郡國二十皆大水。
units.en: Twenty Jing and Yang jurisdictions were underwater.
units.literal: Twenty commanderies and principalities of Jing and Yang suffered great floods.

units.zh: 九月，以太傅何曾爲太宰。
units.en: In the ninth month: He Zeng rose from grand tutor to grand preceptor.
units.literal: In the ninth month He Zeng, grand tutor, was appointed grand preceptor.

units.zh: 辛巳，以尚書令李胤爲司徒。
units.en: Xinsi: Li Yin became steward of the masters of the people.
units.literal: On the day xinsi Li Yin, supervisor of the masters of writing, was appointed steward of the masters of the people.

units.zh: 冬十月，以征北大將軍衛瓘爲尚書令。
units.en: Winter: northern commander Wei Guan took over the secretariat.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month Wei Guan, great general who campaigns north, was appointed supervisor of the masters of writing.

units.zh: 揚州刺史應綽伐吳皖城，斬首五千級，焚穀米百八十萬斛。
units.en: Ying Chuo stormed Wu’s Wan stronghold, counted five thousand kills, and torched nearly two million hu of enemy stores.
units.literal: Ying Chuo, inspector of Yang province, attacked Wu’s fortress at Wan, took five thousand heads, and burned one million eight hundred thousand hu of grain and rice.

units.zh: 十一月辛巳，太醫司馬程據獻雉頭裘，帝以奇技異服典禮所禁，焚之於殿前。
units.en: Xinsi: Cheng Ju, marshal of the imperial physicians, offered a pheasant-skin cloak; the emperor burned it as illegal luxury.
units.literal: On the day xinsi of the eleventh month Cheng Ju, court physician, presented a pheasant-head fur robe; the emperor, because strange skills and exotic garments are forbidden by ritual canon, burned it before the hall.

units.zh: 甲申，敕內外敢有犯者罪之。
units.en: Jiashen: a decree threatened punishment for anyone peddling such finery.
units.literal: On the day jiashen he ordered that inside and outside any who dared violate the rule be punished.

units.zh: 吳昭武將軍劉翻、厲武將軍祖始來降。
units.en: Wu generals Liu Fan and Zu Shi crossed with their commands.
units.literal: Wu’s general who displays martial power Liu Fan and general who displays stern martial power Zu Shi came to surrender.

units.zh: 辛卯，以尚書杜預都督荊州諸軍事。
units.en: Xinmao: Du Yu took supreme command on the Jing front.
units.literal: On the day xinmao Du Yu of the masters of writing was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Jing province.

units.zh: 征南大將軍羊祜卒。
units.en: Yang Hu, the southern expedition commander, died.
units.literal: Yang Hu, great general who campaigns south, died.

units.zh: 十二月乙未，西河王斌薨。
units.en: Yiwei: Sima Bin of Xihe died.
units.literal: On the day yiwei of the twelfth month king Bin of Xihe died.

units.zh: 丁未，太宰朗陵公何曾薨。
units.en: Dingwei: He Zeng, grand preceptor and duke of Langling, died.
units.literal: On the day dingwei He Zeng, grand preceptor and duke of Langling, died.

units.zh: 是歲，東夷九國內附。
units.en: Nine Yi polities entered Jin’s orbit that year.
units.literal: That year nine states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.

units.zh: 五年春正月，虜帥樹機能攻陷涼州。
units.en: Xianning 5 opened with Shujineng’s Di army seizing Liangzhou.
units.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, the tribesman chief Shujineng captured Liang province.

units.zh: 乙丑，使討虜護軍武威太守馬隆擊之。
units.en: Yichou: Ma Long of Wuwei was sent to retake the northwest.
units.literal: On the day yichou he ordered Ma Long, protector general who smites captives and prefect of Wuwei, to attack them.

units.zh: 二月甲午，白麟見于平原。
units.en: Second month, jiawu: a white kirin was sighted in Pingyuan.
units.literal: On the day jiawu of the second month a white unicorn was seen in Pingyuan.

units.zh: 三月，匈奴都督拔弈虛帥部落歸化。
units.en: Third month: Xiongnu chief Bayixu brought his people in.
units.literal: In the third month the Xiongnu superintendent Bayixu led his tribe to submit and be civilized.

units.zh: 乙亥，以百姓饑饉，減御膳之半。
units.en: Yihai: famine in the realm halved the palace table.
units.literal: On the day yihai, because the hundred surnames suffered famine, half of the imperial kitchen’s meals was cut.

units.zh: 有星孛于柳。
units.en: A comet trailed through the Willow mansion.
units.literal: A broom star appeared in the asterism Liu.

units.zh: 夏四月，又孛于女御。
units.en: Summer: a second comet shone in the Nüyu asterism.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, another appeared in Nüyu.

units.zh: 大赦，降除部曲督以下質任。
units.en: Amnesty followed, and hostage rules were eased for hereditary officers down to company level.
units.literal: A great amnesty was declared and hostage requirements were lowered or removed for supervisors of private troops downward.

units.zh: 丁亥，郡國八雨雹，傷秋稼，壞百姓廬舍。
units.en: Dinghai: hailstorms in eight provinces [22] smashed the harvest and flattened homes.
units.literal: On the day dinghai eight commanderies and principalities were struck by hail [22], injuring the autumn crop and ruining commoners’ huts.

units.zh: 秋七月，有星孛于紫宮。
units.en: Seventh month: another comet circled the pole stars.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, a broom star appeared in the Purple Palace.

units.zh: 九月甲午，麟見于河南。
units.en: Ninth month, jiawu: a kirin appeared in Henan commandery.
units.literal: On the day jiawu of the ninth month a unicorn was seen south of the Yellow River.

units.zh: 冬十月戊寅，匈奴餘渠都督獨雍等帥部落歸化。
units.en: Tenth month, wuyin: more Xiongnu bands under Duyong surrendered.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day wuyin, Xiongnu superintendent Duyong of the Yüqu channel and others led their tribes to submit.

units.zh: 汲郡人不準掘魏襄王冢，[23]得竹簡小篆古書十餘萬言，藏于祕府。
units.en: Bu Zhun of Ji opened King Xiang’s Wei tomb [23] and pulled up a huge cache of Warring States bamboo slips for the imperial library.
units.literal: A man of Ji commandery named Bu Zhun dug open the tomb of Wei king Xiang of Wei [23] and obtained more than a hundred thousand words of ancient bamboo documents in small-seal script, which were stored in the secret treasury.

units.zh: 十一月，大舉伐吳，遣鎮軍將軍、琅邪王伷出涂中，[24]安東將軍王渾出江西，建威將軍王戎出武昌，平南將軍胡奮出夏口，鎮南大將軍杜預出江陵，龍驤將軍王濬、廣武將軍唐彬率巴蜀之卒浮江而下，東西凡二十餘萬。
units.en: In the eleventh month: the conquest of Wu opened on every vector—Sima Zhou from Tu, Wang Hun from the north bank, Wang Rong, Hu Fen, Du Yu, and a river fleet under Wang Jun and Tang Bin—over two hundred thousand soldiers [24].
units.literal: In the eleventh month a great campaign was launched against Wu: Sima Zhou, general who guards the army and king of Langye, went out from Tu; Wang Hun, general who guards the east, from west of the river; Wang Rong, general who displays might, from Wuchang; Hu Fen, general who pacifies the south, from Xiakou; Du Yu, great general who guards the south, from Jiangling; Wang Jun, general who displays dragon prowess, and Tang Bin, general who displays martial breadth, led Ba–Shu troops down the Yangzi—more than two hundred thousand men on the eastern and western axes combined [24].

units.zh: 以太尉賈充爲大都督，行冠軍將軍楊濟爲副，總統眾軍。
units.en: Jia Chong, Grand Commandant, was made Grand Commander-in-chief; Yang Ji, acting General Who Displays Champion Prowess, served as his deputy, and together they commanded all the armies.
units.literal: Grand commandant Jia Chong was made supreme commander, with acting general who displays champion prowess Yang Ji as deputy, commanding all hosts.

units.zh: 十二月，馬隆擊叛虜樹機能，大破，斬之，涼州平。
units.en: In the twelfth month: Ma Long killed Shujineng and recovered Liangzhou.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Ma Long struck the mutinous tribesman Shujineng, crushed him utterly, beheaded him, and Liang province was pacified.

units.zh: 肅慎來獻楛矢石砮。
units.en: Sushen foresters sent their classic stone-tipped arrows as tribute.
units.literal: The Sushen people came to present mulberry-wood arrows and stone arrowheads.

units.zh: 太康元年春正月己丑朔，五色氣冠日。
units.en: Taikang opened on jichou with a five-hued halo around the sun.
units.literal: In the first year of Taikang, spring, first month, on the first day jichou, five-colored vapors crowned the sun.

units.zh: 癸丑，王渾克吳尋陽賴鄉諸城，獲吳武威將軍周興。
units.en: Guichou: Wang Hun captured the various Wu cities of Laixiang in Xunyang and took Zhou Xing, Wu’s General of Martial Might.
units.literal: On the day guichou Wang Hun took Wu’s towns around Xunyang and Lai township, capturing Wu’s general who displays martial might Zhou Xing.

units.zh: 二月戊午，王濬、唐彬等克丹楊城。
units.en: Second month, wuwu: the river fleet seized Danyang.
units.literal: On the day wuwu of the second month Wang Jun, Tang Bin, and others took Danyang city.

units.zh: 庚申，又克西陵，殺西陵都督、鎮軍將軍留憲，[25]征南將軍成璩，西陵監鄭廣。
units.en: Gengshen: Xiling fell; Liu Xian, Cheng Qu, and Zheng Guang died defending it [25].
units.literal: On the day gengshen they also took Xiling, killing Xiling commander and general who guards the army Liu Xian [25], general who campaigns south Cheng Qu, and Xiling intendant Zheng Guang.

units.zh: 壬戌，濬又克夷道樂鄉城，殺夷道監陸晏、水軍都督陸景。
units.en: Renxu: Wang Jun pushed to Yidao and Lexiang and killed Lu Yan and Lu Jing.
units.literal: On the day renxu Jun further took Yidao and Lexiang towns, killing Yidao intendant Lu Yan and commander of the navy Lu Jing.

units.zh: 甲戌，杜預克江陵，斬吳江陵督伍延；
units.en: Jiaxu: Du Yu entered Jiangling and executed Wu Yan;
units.literal: On the day jiaxu Du Yu took Jiangling and beheaded Wu’s Jiangling commander Wu Yan;

units.zh: 平南將軍胡奮克江安。
units.en: Hu Fen secured Jiang’an.
units.literal: General who pacifies the south Hu Fen took Jiang’an.

units.zh: 於是諸軍並進，樂鄉、荊門諸戍相次來降。
units.en: Fort after fort—Lexiang, Jingmen—raised white flags.
units.literal: Thereupon all armies advanced together, and the garrisons at Lexiang, Jingmen, and others surrendered in succession.

units.zh: 乙亥，以濬爲都督益、梁二州諸軍事，復下詔曰：「濬、彬東下，掃除巴丘，與胡奮、王戎共平夏口、武昌，順流長騖，直造秣陵，與奮、戎審量其宜。
units.en: On yihai, Wang Jun was made commander-in-chief of military affairs in Yi and Liang provinces, and an edict was again issued, saying, "Jun and Bin shall go east, sweep away Baqiu, and together with Hu Fen and Wang Rong pacify Xiakou and Wuchang, drive swiftly down the current, and go straight to Moling; with Fen and Rong, carefully measure what is appropriate.
units.literal: On the day yihai Wang Jun was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Yi and Liang provinces, and an edict further said: “When Jun and Bin sail east, clear Baqiu, join Hu Fen and Wang Rong to pacify Xiakou and Wuchang, then drive straight down the stream to Moling with Fen and Rong coordinating as fits.

units.zh: 杜預當鎮靜零、桂，懷輯衡陽。
units.en: Du Yu was to hold the southern Jing pocket and win over Hengyang.
units.literal: Du Yu shall keep calm over Ling and Gui and soothe Hengyang.

units.zh: 大兵既過，荊州南境固當傳檄而定，預當分萬人給濬，七千給彬。
units.en: After the main thrust, Du Yu was to feed ten thousand troops to Wang Jun and seven thousand to Tang Bin.
units.literal: Once the great army has passed, the southern marches of Jing ought to be settled by proclamation alone; Yu shall detach ten thousand men to Jun and seven thousand to Bin.

units.zh: 夏口既平，奮宜以七千人給濬。
units.en: When Xiakou fell, Hu Fen was to shift seven thousand soldiers to Wang Jun.
units.literal: Once Xiakou is pacified, Fen should give seven thousand men to Jun.

units.zh: 武昌既了，戎當以六千人增彬。
units.en: After Wuchang, Wang Rong was to reinforce Tang Bin with six thousand.
units.literal: Once Wuchang is settled, Rong should add six thousand men to Bin.

units.zh: 太尉充移屯項，總督諸方。」
units.en: Jia Chong would move headquarters to Xiang and coordinate all theaters.”
units.literal: Grand commandant Chong shall shift his camp to Xiang and oversee every front.”

units.zh: 濬進破夏口、武昌，遂泛舟東下，所至皆平。
units.en: Wang Jun smashed the river defenses and swept downstream unopposed.
units.literal: Jun advanced, broke Xiakou and Wuchang, then sailed east; wherever he went it was pacified.

units.zh: 王渾、周浚與吳丞相張悌戰于版橋，大破之，斬悌及其將孫震、沈瑩，傳首洛陽。
units.en: At Banqiao Wang Hun and Zhou Jun killed Zhang Ti and his generals Sun Zhen and Shen Ying and shipped the heads north.
units.literal: Wang Hun, Zhou Jun, and Wu chancellor Zhang Ti fought at Banqiao; they crushed him, beheaded Ti and his generals Sun Zhen and Shen Ying, and sent the heads to Luoyang.

units.zh: 孫皓窮蹙請降，送璽綬於琅邪王伷。
units.en: Sun Hao capitulated, handing the imperial seal to Sima Zhou.
units.literal: Sun Hao, driven to extremity, asked to surrender and sent the seal and cord to king Zhou of Langye.

units.zh: 三月壬寅，王濬以舟師至于建鄴之石頭，[27]孫皓大懼，面縳輿櫬，降于軍門。
units.en: Third month, renyin: Wang Jun’s ships closed on Stone City [27]; Sun Hao came out bound, coffin in tow.
units.literal: On the day renyin of the third month Wang Jun’s fleet reached Shitou at Jianye [27]; Sun Hao was terrified, bound his own hands, and brought a coffin to surrender at the camp gate.

units.zh: 濬杖節解縛焚櫬，送于京都。
units.en: Wang Jun freed him, burned the surrender coffin, and escorted him to Luoyang.
units.literal: Jun, bearing the staff of authority, loosed his bonds, burned the coffin, and sent him to the capital.

units.zh: 收其圖籍，克州四，郡四十三，縣三百一十三，戶五十二萬三千，吏三萬二千，兵二十三萬，男女口二百三十萬。
units.en: The tally: four provinces, forty-three commanderies, three hundred thirteen counties, 523,000 households, 32,000 officials, 230,000 troops, and 2.3 million people.
units.literal: They collected his maps and registers, took four provinces, forty-three commanderies, and three hundred thirteen counties, with five hundred twenty-three thousand households, thirty-two thousand officials, two hundred thirty thousand soldiers, and two million three hundred thousand persons of both sexes.

units.zh: 其牧守已下皆因吳所置，除其苛政，示之簡易，吳人大悅。
units.en: Wu’s local officials stayed at their posts under lighter rule, and the south rejoiced.
units.literal: From shepherds and prefects downward they kept Wu’s incumbents in place, removed harsh government, and showed them simplicity; the people of Wu were greatly pleased.

units.zh: 乙酉，大赦，改元，大酺五日，恤孤老困窮。
units.en: Yiyou [28]: amnesty, new era name, five days of public feasting, and relief for the helpless.
units.literal: On the day yiyou [28] there was a great amnesty, the reign title was changed, general feasting was held for five days, and orphans, the aged, and the destitute were relieved.

units.zh: 夏四月，河東、高平雨雹，傷秋稼。
units.en: Summer hail in Hedong and Gaoping ruined crops.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Hedong and Gaoping were struck by hail that injured the autumn crop.

units.zh: 遣兼侍中張側、黃門侍郎朱震分使揚越，慰其初附。
units.en: Zhang Ce, acting palace attendant, and Zhu Zhen, gentleman of the yellow gate, were sent through Yang and Yue to reassure the newly submitted.
units.literal: Concurrent palace attendant Zhang Ce and gentleman at the yellow gate Zhu Zhen were sent separately to Yang and Yue to console the newly submitted.

units.zh: 白麟見于頓丘。
units.en: A white kirin appeared at Dunqiu.
units.literal: A white unicorn was seen at Dunqiu.

units.zh: 三河、魏郡、弘農雨雹，傷宿麥。
units.en: Hail in the heartland damaged the winter wheat.
units.literal: Sanhe, Wei commandery, and Hongnong were struck by hail that injured the winter wheat.

units.zh: 五月辛亥，封孫皓爲歸命侯，拜其太子爲中郎，諸子爲郎中。
units.en: Xinhai of the fifth month: Sun Hao was enfeoffed as marquis who returns the mandate; his crown prince was appointed gentleman of the interior, and his other sons gentlemen.
units.literal: On the day xinhai Sun Hao was enfeoffed as marquis who returns his mandate; his crown prince was appointed gentleman of the interior, his sons gentlemen.

units.zh: 吳之舊望，隨才擢敘。
units.en: Wu’s gentry elite were ranked by merit and given posts.
units.literal: Wu’s old notables were promoted and ordered according to their talents.

units.zh: 孫氏大將戰亡之家徙於壽陽，將吏渡江復十年，百姓及百工復二十年。
units.en: Families of Sun generals who had died in battle were moved to Shouyang; officers and clerks who had crossed the Yangzi had labor remitted for ten years, commoners and artisans for twenty.
units.literal: Households of Wu’s great generals who died in battle were moved to Shouyang; officers and clerks who crossed the Yangzi had labor remitted ten years, commoners and artisans twenty years.

units.zh: 丙寅，帝臨軒大會，引皓升殿，群臣咸稱萬歲。
units.en: Bingyin [29]: the emperor came to the hall for a great assembly, led Sun Hao up into the hall, and the ministers all cried 'ten thousand years.'
units.literal: On the day bingyin [29] the emperor came to the gallery for a great assembly, led Hao up the hall, and the host of ministers cried “ten thousand years.”

units.zh: 丁卯，薦酃淥酒于太廟。
units.en: Dingmao: Linglu wine was poured for the ancestors.
units.literal: On the day dingmao fine wine from Linglu was offered in the grand temple.

units.zh: 郡國六雹，傷秋稼。
units.en: Six more provinces reported hail damage.
units.literal: Six commanderies and principalities were struck by hail that injured the autumn crop.

units.zh: 庚午，詔諸士卒年六十以上罷歸于家。
units.en: Gengwu: veterans over sixty were sent home.
units.literal: On the day gengwu an edict ordered soldiers aged sixty and above dismissed home.

units.zh: 庚辰，以王濬爲輔國大將軍、襄陽侯，杜預當陽侯，王戎安豐侯，唐彬上庸侯，賈充、琅邪王伷以下增封。
units.en: Gengchen: Wang Jun was made great general who assists the state and marquis of Xiangyang, Du Yu marquis of Dangyang, Wang Rong marquis of Anfeng, Tang Bin marquis of Shangyong, and Jia Chong, Sima Zhou the king of Langye, and those below them received increased fiefs.
units.literal: On the day gengchen Wang Jun was made great general who assists the state and marquis of Xiangyang, Du Yu marquis of Dangyang, Wang Rong marquis of Anfeng, Tang Bin marquis of Shangyong, and Jia Chong, king Zhou of Langye, and those below received increased fiefs.

units.zh: 於是論功行封，賜公卿以下帛各有差。
units.en: Silks followed to the whole bureaucracy graded by service.
units.literal: Thereupon merit was weighed and enfeoffments granted, and silks were bestowed on the dukes and ministers downward, each according to difference.

units.zh: 六月丁丑，初置翊軍校尉官。
units.en: Sixth month, dingchou: a new “flying guard” colonelcy was added.
units.literal: On the day dingchou of the sixth month the office of colonel of the flying guard was first established.

units.zh: 封丹水侯睦爲高陽王。
units.en: Sima Mu, marquis of Danshui, was enfeoffed as king of Gaoyang.
units.literal: Marquis Mu of Danshui was established as king of Gaoyang.

units.zh: 甲申，東夷十國歸化。
units.en: Jiashen: ten Yi realms sent submission.
units.literal: On the day jiashen ten states of the eastern Yi submitted.

units.zh: 秋七月，虜軻成泥寇西平、浩亹，殺督將以下三百餘人。
units.en: Seventh month: steppe raider Kecheni hit Xiping and Haomen, killing three hundred officers.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the tribesman Kecheni raided Xiping and Haomen, killing more than three hundred commanders and captains downward.

units.zh: 東夷二十國朝獻。
units.en: Twenty Yi embassies arrived at court.
units.literal: Twenty states of the eastern Yi came to court with tribute.

units.zh: 庚寅，以尚書魏舒爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Gengyin: Wei Shu became right vice-president.
units.literal: On the day gengyin Wei Shu of the masters of writing was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the right.

units.zh: 八月，車師前部遣子入侍。
units.en: In the eighth month the forward division of Cheshi sent a son to serve at court.
units.literal: In the eighth month the forward division of Cheshi sent a son as hostage at court.

units.zh: 己未，封皇弟延祚爲樂平王。
units.en: Jiwei: the imperial younger brother Yanzuo was enfeoffed as king of Leping.
units.literal: On the day jiwei the imperial younger brother Yanzuo was enfeoffed as king of Leping.

units.zh: 白龍三見于永昌。
units.en: Three white dragons were reported in Yongchang.
units.literal: Three white dragons were seen at Yongchang.

units.zh: 九月，群臣以天下一統，屢請封襌，帝謙讓弗許。
units.en: In the ninth month, because the realm was unified, the assembled ministers repeatedly requested the Feng and Shan sacrifices; the emperor modestly declined and did not permit it.
units.literal: In the ninth month the host of ministers, because the realm was unified, repeatedly requested the Feng and Shan sacrifices; the emperor modestly declined and did not grant it.

units.zh: 冬十月丁巳，除五女復。
units.en: Dingsi: the five-daughter corvée waiver was canceled.
units.literal: On the day dingsi of the tenth month the exemption for households with five daughters was removed.

units.zh: 十二月戊辰，廣漢王贊薨。
units.en: Twelfth month, wuchen: Sima Zan, king of Guanghan, died.
units.literal: On the day wuchen of the twelfth month king Zan of Guanghan died.

units.zh: 二年春二月，淮南、丹楊地震。
units.en: Taikang 2, spring, second month: Huainan and Danyang suffered earthquakes.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, second month, Huainan and Danyang suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 三月丙申，安平王敦薨。
units.en: Third month, bingshen: Sima Dun of Anping died.
units.literal: On the day bingshen of the third month king Dun of Anping died.

units.zh: 賜王公以下吳生口各有差。
units.en: Wu prisoners were parceled out to Jin nobles by rank.
units.literal: Captives from Wu below the rank of king and duke were bestowed on the nobility, each according to difference.

units.zh: 詔選孫皓妓妾五千人入宮。
units.en: Five thousand of Sun Hao’s harem women were drafted into the harem.
units.literal: An edict ordered five thousand singing-girls and concubines of Sun Hao selected for the palace.

units.zh: 東夷五國朝獻。
units.en: Five Yi states sent tribute that spring.
units.literal: Five states of the eastern Yi came to court with tribute.

units.zh: 夏六月，東夷五國內附。
units.en: Summer, sixth month: five states of the eastern Yi submitted.
units.literal: In summer, the sixth month, five states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.

units.zh: 郡國十六雨雹，大風拔樹，壞百姓廬舍。
units.en: Hail and gales tore through sixteen provinces.
units.literal: Sixteen commanderies and principalities were struck by hail; great winds uprooted trees and ruined commoners’ huts.

units.zh: 江夏、泰山水，流居人三百餘家。
units.en: Floods at Jiangxia and Mount Tai swept away more than three hundred households.
units.literal: Jiangxia and Mount Tai suffered floods that swept away more than three hundred households.

units.zh: 秋七月，上黨又暴風雨雹，傷秋稼。
units.en: Seventh month: Shangdang’s storms ruined the harvest.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Shangdang again had violent wind, rain, and hail that injured the autumn crop.

units.zh: 八月，有星孛于張。
units.en: Eighth month: a broom star appeared in the Zhang lunar lodge.
units.literal: In the eighth month a broom star appeared in Zhang.

units.zh: 冬十月，鮮卑慕容廆寇昌黎。
units.en: Winter, tenth month: Murong Hui of the Xianbei raided Changli.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month Murong Hui of the Xianbei raided Changli.

units.zh: 十一月壬寅，大司馬陳騫薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Grand Marshal Chen Qian died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, the Grand Marshal Chen Qian died.

units.zh: 有星孛于軒轅。
units.en: A comet appeared in Xuanyuan.
units.literal: There was a broom star in Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 鮮卑寇遼西，平州刺史鮮于嬰討破之。
units.en: When Xianbei raided Liaoxi, Xianyu Ying, Inspector of Pingzhou, attacked and defeated them.
units.literal: The Xianbei raided Liaoxi; Xianyu Ying, Inspector of Pingzhou, campaigned against them and defeated them.

units.en: [30] The recension marks commentary note thirty here.
units.literal: [30] Commentary marker thirty stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 三年春正月丁丑，罷秦州，并雍州。
units.en: Taikang 3, spring, first month, dingchou: Qin province was abolished and merged into Yong province.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day dingchou, Qin province was abolished and merged into Yong.

units.zh: 甲午，以尚書張華都督幽州諸軍事。
units.en: Jiawu: Zhang Hua, a master of writing, was appointed commander of all military affairs in You province.
units.literal: On the day jiawu Zhang Hua of the masters of writing was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of You province.

units.zh: 三月，安北將軍嚴詢敗鮮卑慕容廆於昌黎，殺傷數萬人。
units.en: Third month: Yan Xun shattered Murong Hui at Changli with casualties in the tens of thousands.
units.literal: In the third month Yan Xun, general who guards the north, defeated Murong Hui of the Xianbei at Changli, killing or wounding several tens of thousands.

units.zh: 夏四月庚午，太尉、魯公賈充薨。
units.en: In summer, in the fourth month, on the gengwu day, Jia Chong, Grand Commandant and Duke of Lu, died.
units.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the gengwu day, Jia Chong, Grand Commandant and Duke of Lu, died.

units.zh: 閏月丙子，司徒、廣陸侯李胤薨。
units.en: Intercalary bingzi: Li Yin, Minister over the Masses and marquis of Guanglu, died.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day bingzi, Li Yin, minister over the masses and marquis of Guanglu, died.

units.zh: 癸丑，白龍二見于濟南。
units.en: Guichou: twin white dragons appeared at Jinan.
units.literal: On the day guichou two white dragons were seen at Jinan.

units.zh: 秋七月，罷平州、寧州刺史三年一入奏事。
units.en: Seventh month [31]: the requirement that the inspectors of Ping province and Ning province come to court to report once every three years was abolished.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month [31], the requirement that the inspectors of Ping province and Ning province come to court to report once every three years was abolished.

units.zh: 九月，東夷二十九國歸化，獻其方物。
units.en: Twenty-nine Yi realms sent tribute that autumn.
units.literal: In the ninth month twenty-nine states of the eastern Yi submitted and presented their local products.

units.zh: 吳故將莞恭、帛奉舉兵反，攻害建鄴令，遂圍揚州，徐州刺史嵇喜討平之。
units.en: Two ex-Wu officers, Guan Gong and Bo Feng, murdered the Jianye magistrate and besieged Yangzhou until Xu inspector Ji Xi crushed the rising.
units.literal: Former Wu generals Guan Gong and Bo Feng raised troops in revolt, killed the magistrate of Jianye, then besieged Yang province; Ji Xi, inspector of Xu province, campaigned and pacified them.

units.zh: 冬十二月甲申，以司空齊王攸爲大司馬、督青州諸軍事，鎮東大將軍、琅邪王伷爲撫軍大將軍，[32]汝南王亮爲太尉，光祿大夫山濤爲司徒，尚書令衛瓘爲司空。
units.en: Winter, twelfth month, jiashen: Sima You, King of Qi and Minister of Works, was made Grand Marshal and supervisor of all military affairs in Qing province; Sima Zhou, Great General Who Garrisons the East and King of Langye, was made Great General Who Pacifies the Army; [32] Sima Liang, King of Runan, was made Grand Commandant; Shan Tao, Grand Master of Brilliant Prosperity, was made Minister over the Masses; and Wei Guan, Director of the Secretariat, was made Minister of Works.
units.literal: On the day jiashen of winter, twelfth month, Sima You, king of Qi and minister of works, was made grand marshal and supervisor of all military affairs of Qing province; Sima Zhou, great general who guards the east and king of Langye, was made great general who pacifies the army [32]; Sima Liang, king of Runan, grand commandant; Shan Tao, grand officer of brilliant prosperity, steward of the masters of the people; Wei Guan, supervisor of the masters of writing, minister of works.

units.zh: 丙申，詔四方水旱甚者無出田租。
units.en: Bingshen: disaster counties were forgiven their grain rent.
units.literal: On the day bingshen an edict ordered that regions suffering severe flood or drought pay no field rent.

units.zh: 四年春正月甲申，[33]以尚書右僕射魏舒爲尚書左僕射，下邳王晃爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Taikang 4, spring, first month, jiashen [33]: Wei Shu moved from right vice-president of the secretariat to left vice-president, and Sima Huang, king of Xiapi, became right vice-president.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day jiashen [33], Wei Shu, senior vice-director of the masters of the right, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left, and king Huang of Xiapi senior vice-director of the masters of the right.

units.zh: 戊午，司徒山濤薨。
units.en: Wuwu: Shan Tao died.
units.literal: On the day wuwu Shan Tao, steward of the masters of the people, died.

units.zh: 二月己丑，立長樂亭侯寔爲北海王。
units.en: Jichou of the second month: Shi, marquis of Changle village, was established as king of Beihai.
units.literal: On the day jichou of the second month Shi, marquis of Changleting, was established as king of Beihai.

units.zh: 三月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third month, on the xinchou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third month, on the xinchou new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 癸丑，大司馬齊王攸薨。
units.en: On guichou, Sima You, Prince of Qi and Grand Marshal, died.
units.literal: On guichou, the Grand Marshal You, Prince of Qi, died.

units.zh: 夏四月，任城王陵薨。
units.en: Summer, fourth month: Sima Ling, king of Rencheng, died.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month king Ling of Rencheng died.

units.zh: 五月己亥，大將軍、琅邪王伷薨。
units.en: Jihai of the fifth month: Sima Zhou, great general and king of Langye, died.
units.literal: On the day jihai of the fifth month Sima Zhou, great general and king of Langye, died.

units.zh: 徙遼東王蕤爲東萊王。
units.en: Sima Rui was transferred from king of Liaodong to king of Donglai.
units.literal: King Rui of Liaodong was transferred to be king of Donglai.

units.zh: 六月，增九卿禮秩。
units.en: Sixth month: the ritual stipends of the nine ministers were increased.
units.literal: In the sixth month the ritual stipends of the nine ministers were increased.

units.zh: 牂柯獠二千餘落內屬。
units.en: Over two thousand Zangke Liao hamlets enrolled under Jin.
units.literal: More than two thousand settlements of Zangke Liao submitted as subjects.

units.zh: 秋七月壬子，以尚書右僕射、下邳王晃爲都督青州諸軍事。
units.en: Renzi of the seventh month: Sima Huang, king of Xiapi and right vice-president, was made commander of all military affairs in Qing province.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renzi, king Huang of Xiapi, senior vice-director of the masters of the right, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Qing province.

units.zh: 丙寅，兗州大水，復其田租。
units.en: Bingyin: Yanzhou floods brought tax relief.
units.literal: On the day bingyin Yan province suffered great floods and its field rent was remitted.

units.zh: 八月，鄯善國遣子入侍，假其歸義侯。
units.en: Eighth month: Shanshan sent a son to serve at court, and he was provisionally made marquis who returns to righteousness.
units.literal: In the eighth month the state of Shanshan sent a son as hostage at court and he was given the acting title marquis who returns to righteousness.

units.zh: 以隴西王泰爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Sima Tai of Longxi joined the secretariat as right vice-president.
units.literal: King Tai of Longxi was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the right.

units.zh: 冬十一月戊午，新都王該薨。
units.en: Wuwu of the eleventh month: Sima Gai, king of Xindu, died.
units.literal: On the day wuwu of the eleventh month king Gai of Xindu died.

units.zh: 以尚書左僕射魏舒爲司徒。
units.en: Wei Shu became minister over the masses.
units.literal: Wei Shu of the masters of writing was appointed minister over the masses.

units.zh: 十二月庚午，大閱于宣武觀。
units.en: Gengwu of the twelfth month: a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand.
units.literal: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand.

units.zh: 是歲，河內及荊州、揚州大水。
units.en: That year, Henei and Jing and Yang provinces suffered great floods.
units.literal: That year Henei and Jing and Yang provinces suffered great floods.

units.zh: 五年春正月己亥，青龍二見于武庫井中。
units.en: Taikang 5, jihai: two blue dragons in the Luoyang arsenal well.
units.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day jihai, two azure dragons were seen in the armory well.

units.zh: 二月丙寅，立南宮王子玷爲長樂王。
units.en: Bingyin of the second month: Dian, son of the king of Nangong, was established as king of Changle.
units.literal: On the day bingyin of the second month Dian, son of the king of the southern palace, was established as king of Changle.

units.zh: 壬辰，地震。
units.en: Renchen: the earth shook.
units.literal: On the day renchen there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 夏四月，任城、魯國池水赤如血。
units.en: Summer: ponds in Rencheng and Lu ran blood-red.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the waters of pools in Rencheng and Lu principality turned red as blood.

units.zh: 五月丙午，宣帝廟梁折。
units.en: Bingwu: a roof-beam snapped in Emperor Xuan's temple.
units.literal: On the day bingwu of the fifth month a beam in emperor Xuan’s temple broke.

units.zh: 六月，初置黃沙獄。
units.en: Sixth month: the “Yellow Sand” review prison was created.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Yellow Sand prison was first established.

units.zh: 秋七月戊申，皇子恢薨。
units.en: Seventh month, wushen: the imperial son Hui died.
units.literal: On the day wushen of autumn, seventh month, the imperial son Hui died.

units.zh: 任城、梁國、中山雨雹，傷秋稼。
units.en: Hailstorms in Rencheng, Liang, and Zhongshan ruined crops.
units.literal: Rencheng, Liang principality, and Zhongshan were struck by hail that injured the autumn crop.

units.zh: 減天下戶課三分之一。
units.en: The head tax was cut by a third across the realm.
units.literal: Household levies empire-wide were reduced by one third.

units.zh: 九月，南安大風折木，郡國五大水，隕霜，傷秋稼。
units.en: The ninth month brought gales, floods in five provinces, and black frost.
units.literal: In the ninth month Nan’an had great wind that broke trees; five commanderies and principalities had great floods; killing frost injured the autumn crop.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲辰，太原王輔薨。
units.en: Jiachen of the eleventh month: Sima Fu, king of Taiyuan, died.
units.literal: On the day jiachen of winter, eleventh month, king Fu of Taiyuan died.

units.zh: 十二月庚午，大赦。
units.en: Gengwu of the twelfth month: a great amnesty.
units.literal: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month there was a great amnesty.

units.zh: 林邑、大秦國各遣使來獻。
units.en: Linyi and the state of Da Qin each sent envoys to present tribute.
units.literal: Lin-yi and Da Qin each sent envoys to present tribute.

units.zh: 閏月，鎮南大將軍、當陽侯杜預卒。
units.en: Intercalary month: Du Yu, great general who guards the south and marquis of Dangyang, died.
units.literal: In the intercalary month Du Yu, great general who guards the south and marquis of Dangyang, died.

units.zh: 六年春正月甲申朔，[36]以比歲不登，免租貸宿負。
units.en: Taikang 6, new moon jiashen [36]: years of poor harvests brought rent remission and canceled grain loans.
units.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the first day jiashen [36], because harvests had failed for successive years, rent was remitted and old granary debts forgiven.

units.zh: 戊辰，以征南大將軍王渾爲尚書左僕射，尚書褚䂮都督揚州諸軍事，楊濟都督荊州諸軍事。
units.en: Wuchen: Wang Hun, Great General Who Campaigns South, was made left vice-director of the Secretariat; Chu Xian of the Secretariat was made commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Yang province; and Yang Ji was made commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Jing province.
units.literal: On the day wuchen Wang Hun, great general who campaigns south, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left; Chu Xian of the masters of writing supervisor of all military affairs of Yang province; Yang Ji supervisor of all military affairs of Jing province.

units.zh: 三月，郡國六隕霜，傷桑麥。
units.en: The third month frost hurt mulberries and wheat in six jurisdictions.
units.literal: In the third month six commanderies and principalities had killing frost that injured mulberry and wheat.

units.zh: 夏四月，扶南等十國來獻，參離四千餘落內附。
units.en: Summer: Southeast embassies arrived and four thousand Shenli hamlets yielded.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, ten states including Funan came to present tribute, and more than four thousand settlements of Shenli submitted.

units.zh: 郡國四旱，十大水，壞百姓廬舍。
units.en: Four provinces baked while ten flooded.
units.literal: Four commanderies and principalities had drought; ten had great floods that ruined commoners’ huts.

units.zh: 秋七月，巴西地震。
units.en: Seventh month: Ba-Xi shook.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Ba-Xi suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 八月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Eighth month, new moon bingxu: solar eclipse.
units.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, bingxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 減百姓綿絹三分之一。
units.en: The silk portion of the poll tax was cut by a third.
units.literal: Silk owed by commoners was reduced by one third.

units.zh: 白龍見于京兆。
units.en: A white dragon appeared in the Jingzhao capital region.
units.literal: A white dragon was seen in Jingzhao.

units.zh: 以鎮軍大將軍王濬爲撫軍大將軍。
units.en: Wang Jun traded “guard the army” for “pacify the army” generalship.
units.literal: Wang Jun, great general who guards the army, was appointed great general who pacifies the army.

units.zh: 九月丙子，山陽公劉康薨。
units.en: Bingzi of the ninth month: Liu Kang, duke of Shanyang, died.
units.literal: On the day bingzi of the ninth month Liu Kang, mountain-yang duke, died.

units.zh: 冬十月，南安山崩，水出。
units.en: Winter, tenth month: landslides and flash floods in Nan’an.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month Nan’an’s mountains collapsed and water burst forth.

units.zh: 南陽郡獲兩足獸。
units.en: Nanyang reported a two-legged freak beast.
units.literal: Nanyang commandery captured a two-footed beast.

units.zh: 龜茲、焉耆國遣子入侍。
units.en: Qiuci and Yanqi sent royal hostages.
units.literal: Qiuci and Yanqi each sent a son as hostage at court.

units.zh: 十二月甲申，大閱于宣武觀，旬日而罷。
units.en: Jiashen of the twelfth month: a grand review at the Xuanwu stand lasted ten days.
units.literal: On the day jiashen of the twelfth month a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand and ended after ten days.

units.zh: 庚子，撫軍大將軍、襄陽侯王濬卒。
units.en: Gengzi: Wang Jun, Great General Who Pacifies the Army and Marquis of Xiangyang, died.
units.literal: On the day gengzi Wang Jun, great general who pacifies the army and marquis of Xiangyang, died.

units.zh: 七年春正月甲寅朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: Taikang 7, jiayin: eclipse.
units.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the first day jiayin, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「比年災異屢發，日蝕三朝，地震山崩。
units.en: On yimao, an edict said, "In recent years disasters and anomalies have repeatedly occurred: solar eclipses in three courts, earthquakes, and mountain collapses.
units.literal: On the day yimao an edict said: “In recent years omens have repeatedly appeared—three court mornings with solar eclipses, earthquakes and mountain collapses.

units.zh: 邦之不臧，實在朕躬。
units.en: When the realm falters, the blame lies with me alone.
units.literal: When the state is not good, the fault is truly in my person.

units.zh: 公卿大臣各上封事，極言其故，勿有所諱。」
units.en: I want sealed memorials from every minister, candid and complete.”
units.literal: Let each duke and minister submit a sealed memorial, speaking to the utmost of the reasons, and let none hold back.”

units.zh: 夏五月，郡國十三旱。
units.en: Summer, fifth month: thirteen commanderies and principalities had drought.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, thirteen commanderies and principalities had drought.

units.zh: 鮮卑慕容廆寇遼東。
units.en: Murong Hui of the Xianbei raided Liaodong.
units.literal: Murong Hui of the Xianbei raided Liaodong.

units.zh: 秋七月，朱提山崩，犍爲地震。
units.en: Seventh month: Zhuti mountain fell and Qianwei shook.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month Mount Zhuti collapsed and Qianwei suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 八月，東夷十一國內附。
units.en: Eighth month: eleven Yi peoples asked to join Jin.
units.literal: In the eighth month eleven states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.

units.zh: 京兆地震。
units.en: The capital region trembled.
units.literal: Jingzhao suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 九月戊寅，驃騎將軍、扶風王駿薨。
units.en: Wuyin of the ninth month: Sima Jun, general of the agile cavalry and king of Fufeng, died.
units.literal: On the day wuyin of the ninth month Sima Jun, swift-cavalry general and king of Fufeng, died.

units.zh: 郡國八大水。
units.en: Eight provinces flooded.
